25.34.270.m: Now [the text] says: "The chariot-racers, having approached along the southern path..."—these are declared to be the charioteers and rājanyas.

25.34.270.s: mārutā agreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītyeti kṣattasaṃgrahītāra evaita uktā bhavanti |
25.34.270.d: मारुता अग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्येति क्षत्तसंग्रहीतार एवैत उक्ता भवन्ति ।
25.34.270.m: "The attendants of the Maruts, having gone around in front of the āhavanīya fire..."—these are declared to be the chamberlains and charioteers.

25.34.270.s: atha yajamānaṃ tārpyaṃ paridhāpayatīty ājyenaivaitat tṛptaṃ vāso bhavati |
25.34.270.d: अथ यजमानं तार्प्यं परिधापयतीत्य् आज्येनैवैतत् तृप्तं वासो भवति ।
25.34.270.m: Now regarding [the rule]: "He causes the sacrificer to put on a tārpya garment"—this is a garment saturated with clarified butter.
Now they also relate: there are trees named tṛpā;

25.34.270.s: teṣām evaitad bhavati | athemaṃ vājapeyam̐ sarvasaptadaśam eke bruvate |
25.34.270.d: तेषाम् एवैतद् भवति । अथेमं वाजपेयँ सर्वसप्तदशम् एके ब्रुवते ।
25.34.270.m: it is of them that this is made. Now, some declare this Vājapeya to consist entirely of seventeen-fold stomas.

25.34.270.s: ādeśād eva bṛhatsāmaikavim̐śaṃ vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu stuvīrann iti ||
25.34.270.d: आदेशाद् एव बृहत्सामैकविँशं वैष्णवीषु शिपिविष्टवतीषु स्तुवीरन्न् इति ॥
25.34.270.m: According to the direct injunction alone, they should chant the Bṛhatsāman in the twenty-one-fold stoma on the verses to Viṣṇu containing the word 'śipiviṣṭa'.

26.1.271.d: अथायँ राजसूयो ऽर्धसप्तदशैर् मासैः संतिष्ठते ऽर्धषोडशैर् वा
26.1.271.m: Now, this Rājasūya concludes in sixteen and a half months, or in fifteen and a half.

26.1.271.s: tasmin somasam̐sthāḥ pañcaikāhā ahīno dvirātraḥ ṣaṭ chālās |
26.1.271.d: तस्मिन् सोमसँस्थाः पञ्चैकाहा अहीनो द्विरात्रः षट् छालास् ।
26.1.271.m: In it, there are five one-day soma rituals, an ahīna of two nights, and six sacrificial sheds.

26.1.271.s: aṣṭau yūpāḥ ṣaḍ u hāgniṣṭomikā dvipaśaupaśubandhe sautrāmaṇyām aṣṭamas
26.1.271.d: अष्टौ यूपाः षड् उ हाग्निष्टोमिका द्विपशौपशुबन्धे सौत्रामण्याम् अष्टमस्
26.1.271.m: There are eight sacrificial posts: six belonging to the Agniṣṭoma rituals, [one] for the two-animal animal-sacrifice, and the eighth in the Sautrāmaṇī.

26.1.271.s: tāvanta evāvabhṛthāḥ kva u khalu haviṣo havir nirupyata iti |
26.1.271.d: तावन्त एवावभृथाः क्व उ खलु हविषो हविर् निरुप्यत इति ।
26.1.271.m: There are just as many final baths. Where, indeed, is the oblation poured out from an oblation?

26.1.271.s: ānumata ity eva brūyāt kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ dakṣiṇeti
26.1.271.d: आनुमत इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् कृष्णं वासः कृष्णतूषं दक्षिणेति
26.1.271.m: He should say: "Only in the oblation to Anumati." Regarding [the rule]: "A black garment with a black fringe is the sacrificial gift":

26.1.271.s: kṛṣṇadaśam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati kāmam iṣṭyā paśubandheneti
26.1.271.d: कृष्णदशम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति कामम् इष्ट्या पशुबन्धेनेति
26.1.271.m: with a black hem is what is meant here. Regarding [the rule]: "At will with an iṣṭi or with an animal sacrifice":

26.1.271.s: saṃtanyeṣṭyeṣṭvāgrayaṇena vā pārvaṇena vā yajeta katham u khalu sākamedhaparuṣīti
26.1.271.d: संतन्येष्ट्येष्ट्वाग्रयणेन वा पार्वणेन वा यजेत कथम् उ खलु साकमेधपरुषीति
26.1.271.m: having sacrificed with the Saṃtani iṣṭi, he should sacrifice either with the first-fruits sacrifice or with a seasonal offering. How indeed are the two joints of the Sākamedha [performed]?

26.1.271.s: mahārātre pūrvā saṃtaniḥ śvo bhūta uttarā pradoṣe
26.1.271.d: महारात्रे पूर्वा संतनिः श्वो भूत उत्तरा प्रदोषे
26.1.271.m: In the dead of night is the first Saṃtani; when the morrow has dawned, the second [is performed] at dusk.

26.1.271.s: kimu khalv asamuditaṃ bhavatīti prāg anūyājikāt saṃpraiṣād ity eva brūyāt |
26.1.271.d: किमु खल्व् असमुदितं भवतीति प्राग् अनूयाजिकात् संप्रैषाद् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
26.1.271.m: What, indeed, is performed without recitation? He should say: "Only up to the summons for the after-offerings."

26.1.271.s: bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapati brahmaṇo gṛha iti yo 'nyo yājamānāsaṃyukto brāhmaṇo bhavati
26.1.271.d: बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपति ब्रह्मणो गृह इति यो ऽन्यो याजमानासंयुक्तो ब्राह्मणो भवति
26.1.271.m: Regarding [the rule]: "He pours out an oblation of boiled rice for Bṛhaspati in the house of the Brahman"—this means a brahmin who is other than the one associated with the sacrificer [as priest].
Regarding [the rule]: "[He pours out] an oblation of boiled rice for Bhaga in the house of the favourite wife":

26.1.271.s: yānyā mahiṣyā eva subhagā bhavati nairṛtaṃ caruṃ parivṛktyai gṛha iti
26.1.271.d: यान्या महिष्या एव सुभगा भवति नैरृतं चरुं परिवृक्त्यै गृह इति
26.1.271.m: she who is favored, other than the chief queen. Regarding [the rule]: "[He pours out] an oblation of boiled rice for Nirṛti in the house of the discarded wife":

26.1.271.s: durbhagaivaiṣoktā bhavati pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ bhāgadughasya gṛha iti
26.1.271.d: दुर्भगैवैषोक्ता भवति पौष्णं चरुं भागदुघस्य गृह इति
26.1.271.m: it is the unfavored wife who is spoken of. Regarding [the rule]: "[He pours out] an oblation of boiled rice for Pūṣan in the house of the collector of shares":

26.1.272.s: mahānasika evaiṣa ukto bhavati | athāpy udāharanti yo bhāgalābhī dogdhi sa eṣaiṣa ukto bhavati
26.1.272.d: महानसिक एवैष उक्तो भवति । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति यो भागलाभी दोग्धि स एषैष उक्तो भवति
26.1.272.m: the superintendent of the kitchen is the one referred to. Now they also relate: "He who milks while receiving a share is the one who is referred to."
For twelve days the oblations to the jewel-bearers take place; on the thirteenth, the offering to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.

26.1.272.s: dvyaho 'vaśiṣṭa etasyaiva pūrvapakṣasya tasmin saṃtanībhyāṃ yajeta | atha ced ukthye 'bhiṣecanīye 'gniṃ cinvītaitasminn eva dvirātra āgnikāni sāvitrāṇi hutvokhāḥ saṃbhṛtya paśuśīrṣāṇi ca vāyavyena paśunā yajeta ||
26.1.272.d: द्व्यहो ऽवशिष्ट एतस्यैव पूर्वपक्षस्य तस्मिन् संतनीभ्यां यजेत । अथ चेद् उक्थ्ये ऽभिषेचनीये ऽग्निं चिन्वीतैतस्मिन्न् एव द्विरात्र आग्निकानि सावित्राणि हुत्वोखाः संभृत्य पशुशीर्षाणि च वायव्येन पशुना यजेत ॥
26.1.272.m: Two days remain of this very same fortnight; on them, he should sacrifice with the two Saṃtani offerings. If he piles the fire altar at the Ukthya of the consecration ceremony, he should, during this very same two-night period, offer the Sāvitra libations relating to the fire altar, gather the pots and the heads of the victims, and sacrifice with the victim for Vāyu.

26.2.272.s: apāṃ patir asi | ity apāṃpatīyāḥ samudriyāṇām evaitā uktā bhavanti
26.2.272.d: अपां पतिर् असि । इत्य् अपांपतीयाः समुद्रियाणाम् एवैता उक्ता भवन्ति
26.2.272.m: Regarding [the formulas]: "Thou art the lord of the waters"—these are the Apāṃpatīya waters; they are declared to be those taken from the sea.

26.2.272.s: marutām oja stha | iti niveṣṭyās | āvartānām evaitā uktā bhavanti
26.2.272.d: मरुताम् ओज स्थ । इति निवेष्ट्यास् । आवर्तानाम् एवैता उक्ता भवन्ति
26.2.272.m: Regarding [the formula]: "Ye are the vigor of the Maruts"—these are the eddying waters; they are declared to be those taken from whirlpools.

26.2.272.s: sūryavarcasa stha | ity abhidṛśyāḥ prasannānām evaitā uktā bhavanti
26.2.272.d: सूर्यवर्चस स्थ । इत्य् अभिदृश्याः प्रसन्नानाम् एवैता उक्ता भवन्ति
26.2.272.m: Regarding [the formula]: "Ye have the luster of the sun"—these are the waters exposed to view; they are declared to be those that are clear.

26.2.272.s: śakvarī stha | iti gor u jarāyor evaitā uktā bhavanti
26.2.272.d: शक्वरी स्थ । इति गोर् उ जरायोर् एवैता उक्ता भवन्ति
26.2.272.m: Regarding [the formula]: "Ye are the mighty ones"—they are declared to be the waters from the afterbirth of a cow.

26.2.272.s: so 'traivāgneyenāṣṭākapālena yajeteti sadyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhamāna ukthya etat sūtraṃ bhavaty atha ced atipravardheta tadānīm evāgneyenāṣṭākapālena yajeta
26.2.272.d: सो ऽत्रैवाग्नेयेनाष्टाकपालेन यजेतेति सद्यः संतिष्ठमान उक्थ्य एतत् सूत्रं भवत्य् अथ चेद् अतिप्रवर्धेत तदानीम् एवाग्नेयेनाष्टाकपालेन यजेत
26.2.272.m: Regarding [the rule]: "He should sacrifice then and there with an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni"—this rule applies if the Ukthya concludes on the same day; but if it extends over, he should sacrifice then and there with an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni.

26.2.273.s: śvo bhūte sārasvatena daśadaśātra camasam abhisaṃjānata iti
26.2.273.d: श्वो भूते सारस्वतेन दशदशात्र चमसम् अभिसंजानत इति
26.2.273.m: When the morrow has dawned, with [the cake] for Sarasvatī. Regarding [the rule]: "Here ten and ten recognize their goblet":

26.2.273.s: hotṛcamase codgātṛcamase ca saptasapta | athetareṣu navanava
26.2.273.d: होतृचमसे चोद्गातृचमसे च सप्तसप्त । अथेतरेषु नवनव
26.2.273.m: seven each are at the goblet of the Hotṛ and at the goblet of the Udgātṛ; then at the others, nine each.

26.2.273.s: prasarpaṇaprabhṛtaya evaite bhavanty apsuṣomāntās | athāyaṃ pratīcīnastomaḥ keśavapanīyo 'tirātraḥ ṣoḍaśiko bhavati
26.2.273.d: प्रसर्पणप्रभृतय एवैते भवन्त्य् अप्सुषोमान्तास् । अथायं प्रतीचीनस्तोमः केशवपनीयो ऽतिरात्रः षोडशिको भवति
26.2.273.m: These [rites] begin with the gliding forward and end with the Soma in the waters. Now this Pratīcīnastoma Keśavapanīya Atirātra has the Ṣoḍaśin.

26.2.273.s: tasya hāgniṣṭomikāni stotrāṇy āvṛttāni bhavanty ekavim̐śo bahiṣpavamānaḥ saptadaśāny ājyāni mādhyaṃdinaś ca pavamānaḥ pañcadaśāni pṛṣṭhāny ārbhavaś ca pavamānas trivṛdyajñāyajñiyam iti |
26.2.273.d: तस्य हाग्निष्टोमिकानि स्तोत्राण्य् आवृत्तानि भवन्त्य् एकविँशो बहिष्पवमानः सप्तदशान्य् आज्यानि माध्यंदिनश् च पवमानः पञ्चदशानि पृष्ठान्य् आर्भवश् च पवमानस् त्रिवृद्यज्ञायज्ञियम् इति ।
26.2.273.m: Its Agniṣṭoma chants are reversed: the Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-one-fold, the Ājya stotras and the Mādhyandina Pavamāna are seventeen-fold, the Pṛṣṭha stotras and the Ārbhava Pavamāna are fifteen-fold, and the Yajñāyajñīya is nine-fold.
Then he undergoes consecration for the Pratīcīnastoma Keśavapanīya Atirātra.

26.2.273.s: tasya ṣaḍ dīkṣāḥ ṣaḍ upasadas trayodaśyāṃ prasutaś caturdaśyām udavasānam
26.2.273.d: तस्य षड् दीक्षाः षड् उपसदस् त्रयोदश्यां प्रसुतश् चतुर्दश्याम् उदवसानम्
26.2.273.m: It has six consecration days and six Upasad days; on the thirteenth day the pressing takes place; on the fourteenth is the concluding bath and departure.

26.2.273.s: athaitasminn eva pakṣāvaśeṣe vyuṣṭaye dvirātrāya dīkṣate
26.2.273.d: अथैतस्मिन्न् एव पक्षावशेषे व्युष्टये द्विरात्राय दीक्षते
26.2.273.m: Then, in the remainder of this very same fortnight, he undergoes consecration for the Vyuṣṭi two-night sacrifice.

26.2.273.s: sa etāṃ caikām̐ rātriṃ pūrvapakṣasya dīkṣito bhavati dve cāparapakṣasya
26.2.273.d: स एतां चैकाँ रात्रिं पूर्वपक्षस्य दीक्षितो भवति द्वे चापरपक्षस्य
26.2.273.m: He remains consecrated for this one night of the waxing fortnight and for two nights of the waning fortnight.

26.2.273.s: athopavasati | athopavasathīye 'hany amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvam ahar bhavaty uttarasminn uttaram iti
26.2.273.d: अथोपवसति । अथोपवसथीये ऽहन्य् अमावास्यायां पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् उत्तरस्मिन्न् उत्तरम् इति
26.2.273.m: Then he keeps fast; then on the fast-day, on the new-moon day, the first day [of the soma sacrifice] occurs; on the next [day], the next.

26.2.273.s: saṃtiṣṭhate vyuṣṭir dvirātras | athottarām̐ śālām adhyavasyet |
26.2.273.d: संतिष्ठते व्युष्टिर् द्विरात्रस् । अथोत्तराँ शालाम् अध्यवस्येत् ।
26.2.273.m: The Vyuṣṭi two-night sacrifice concludes. Then he should move to the northern hall.
Then, having churned out the fires and distributed them, he undergoes consecration for the concluding Agniṣṭoma.

26.2.274.s: tasya tisro dīkṣās tisra upasadaḥ saptamyāṃ prasutaḥ
26.2.274.d: तस्य तिस्रो दीक्षास् तिस्र उपसदः सप्तम्यां प्रसुतः
26.2.274.m: It has three consecration days and three Upasad days; on the seventh day the pressing takes place.
This concluding Agniṣṭoma terminates with a gift of a thousand [cows].

26.2.274.s: athaitasminn eva pakṣāvaśeṣe kṣatrasya dhṛtinābhividhatte devikāhavirbhis traidhātavīyayā sautrāmaṇyeti
26.2.274.d: अथैतस्मिन्न् एव पक्षावशेषे क्षत्रस्य धृतिनाभिविधत्ते देविकाहविर्भिस् त्रैधातवीयया सौत्रामण्येति
26.2.274.m: Then, in the remainder of this very same fortnight, he arranges [the ceremonies] with the Kṣatradhṛti, the Devikā oblations, the Traidhātavīyā iṣṭi, and the Sautrāmaṇī.
The Rājasūya concludes in sixteen and a half months.
Now according to Śālīki, it ends with the Keśavapanīya; those [months] are fifteen and a half.

26.3.274.d: अथातो ऽञ्जसवः प्रसिद्धम् एव प्रथमो ऽर्धमासः संतिष्ठते
26.3.274.m: Now the rapid course [of the Rājasūya]: in the standard manner the first half-month is concluded.

26.3.274.s: pañcāhena cāturmāsyāni dvyahena saṃtanī aṣṭame 'hanīndraturīyaṃ navame 'hni pūrvāṇi devikāhavīm̐ṣi daśame 'hny uttarāṇy ekādaśe dvādaśe trayodaśa iti triṣaṃyuktaiś caturdaśe vaiśvānaro dvādaśakapālaḥ pañcadaśe vāruṇo yavamayaś carur iti māsas |
26.3.274.d: पञ्चाहेन चातुर्मास्यानि द्व्यहेन संतनी अष्टमे ऽहनीन्द्रतुरीयं नवमे ऽह्नि पूर्वाणि देविकाहवीँषि दशमे ऽह्न्य् उत्तराण्य् एकादशे द्वादशे त्रयोदश इति त्रिषंयुक्तैश् चतुर्दशे वैश्वानरो द्वादशकपालः पञ्चदशे वारुणो यवमयश् चरुर् इति मासस् ।
26.3.274.m: In five days the Cāturmāsyas; in two days the two Saṃtani offerings; on the eighth day the Indraturīya; on the ninth day the earlier Devikā oblations; on the tenth day the later ones; on the eleventh, twelfth, and thirteenth days the offerings connected in triads; on the fourteenth the twelve-pot-sherd cake to Vaiśvānara; on the fifteenth the barley mess to Varuṇa—this makes one month.

26.3.274.s: dvādaśāhena ratninām̐ havīm̐ṣi trayodaśe maitrābārhaspatyaṃ dvyahena saṃtanī ardhamāsenābhiṣecanīya ukthya iti dvau māsau |
26.3.274.d: द्वादशाहेन रत्निनाँ हवीँषि त्रयोदशे मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यं द्व्यहेन संतनी अर्धमासेनाभिषेचनीय उक्थ्य इति द्वौ मासौ ।
26.3.274.m: In twelve days the oblations to the jewel-bearers; on the thirteenth the offering to Mitra and Bṛhaspati; in two days the two Saṃtani offerings; in a half-month the Ukthya of the consecration ceremony—this makes two months.

26.3.274.s: ardhamāsena saptadaśo daśapeyo 'rdhamāsaṃ dīkṣite dīkṣitavratīti trayo māsās |
26.3.274.d: अर्धमासेन सप्तदशो दशपेयो ऽर्धमासं दीक्षिते दीक्षितव्रतीति त्रयो मासास् ।
26.3.274.m: In a half-month the seventeen-fold Daśapeya; for half a month he observes the vows of the consecrated while remaining consecrated—this makes three months.

26.3.274.s: ardhamāsena pratīcīnastomaḥ keśavapanīyo 'tirātro 'rdhamāsena vyuṣṭirdvirātra iti catvāro māsās |
26.3.274.d: अर्धमासेन प्रतीचीनस्तोमः केशवपनीयो ऽतिरात्रो ऽर्धमासेन व्युष्टिर्द्विरात्र इति चत्वारो मासास् ।
26.3.274.m: In a half-month the Pratīcīnastoma Keśavapanīya Atirātra; in a half-month the Vyuṣṭi two-night sacrifice—this makes four months.

26.3.274.s: te 'rdhapañcamās | atha śālīkeḥ saptāhena pavitro 'gniṣṭomaḥ sa evam eva pakṣāvaśeṣam̐ siddham ā vāruṇād dvādaśāhena ratninām̐ havīm̐ṣi trayodaśe maitrābārhaspatyaṃ dvyahena saṃtanī iti māsas |
26.3.274.d: ते ऽर्धपञ्चमास् । अथ शालीकेः सप्ताहेन पवित्रो ऽग्निष्टोमः स एवम् एव पक्षावशेषँ सिद्धम् आ वारुणाद् द्वादशाहेन रत्निनाँ हवीँषि त्रयोदशे मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यं द्व्यहेन संतनी इति मासस् ।
26.3.274.m: Those [months] are four and a half. Now according to Śālīki: the agniṣṭoma is a Pavitra lasting seven days; in that very way the remainder of the fortnight is established up to the Vāruṇa [offering]; by twelve days the offerings of the jewel-bearers [are performed]; on the thirteenth, the offering to Mitra-and-Bṛhaspati; by two days the Saṃtanī offerings: thus is one month.

26.3.275.s: ardhamāsenābhiṣecanīya ukthyo 'rdhamāsena saptadaśo daśapeya iti dvau māsau |
26.3.275.d: अर्धमासेनाभिषेचनीय उक्थ्यो ऽर्धमासेन सप्तदशो दशपेय इति द्वौ मासौ ।
26.3.275.m: By half a month, the Abhiṣecanīya is an ukthya; by half a month, the Daśapeya of seventeen [stomas]: thus are two months.

26.3.275.s: ardhamāsena pratīcīnastomaḥ keśavapanīyo 'tirātro 'rdhamāsena vyuṣṭir dvirātra iti trayo māsās |
26.3.275.d: अर्धमासेन प्रतीचीनस्तोमः केशवपनीयो ऽतिरात्रो ऽर्धमासेन व्युष्टिर् द्विरात्र इति त्रयो मासास् ।
26.3.275.m: By half a month, the Keśavapanīya of reversed chants is an atirātra; by half a month, the Vyuṣṭi is a two-night ritual: thus are three months.

26.3.275.s: ardhamāsena kṣatrasya dhṛtir iti te 'rdhacaturthās | atha patantakas |
26.3.275.d: अर्धमासेन क्षत्रस्य धृतिर् इति ते ऽर्धचतुर्थास् । अथ पतन्तकस् ।
26.3.275.m: By half a month, the Kṣatrasya Dhṛti [takes place]: these are three and a half [months]. Now the Patantaka [scheme]:

26.3.275.d: द्वादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदः सप्ताहो ऽहीनो राजसूयस् ।
26.3.275.m: Twelve initiations, twelve upasad-days, the seven-day period is the uninterrupted Rājasūya ritual.

26.3.275.s: yathāvakāśam itarai rājasūyahavirbhir yajate | atha devikāhavirbhir yajate |
26.3.275.d: यथावकाशम् इतरै राजसूयहविर्भिर् यजते । अथ देविकाहविर्भिर् यजते ।
26.3.275.m: According to the opportunity, he sacrifices with the other Rājasūya oblations; then he sacrifices with the Devikā oblations;

26.3.275.s: atha traidhātavīyayā yajate | atha sautrāmaṇyā yajate
26.3.275.d: अथ त्रैधातवीयया यजते । अथ सौत्रामण्या यजते
26.3.275.m: then he sacrifices with the Traidhātavīyā offering; then he sacrifices with the Sautrāmaṇī offering.

26.4.275.s: athemam iṣṭikalpaṃ pañcadaśasāmidhenīkaṃ ca saptadaśasāmidhenīkaṃ ca samāmanāmas
26.4.275.d: अथेमम् इष्टिकल्पं पञ्चदशसामिधेनीकं च सप्तदशसामिधेनीकं च समामनामस्
26.4.275.m: Now we hand down by tradition this procedure for the primary sacrifice, both that having fifteen kindling verses and that having seventeen kindling verses.
There, the duties of the sacrificer are established as the procedure of Baudhāyana.

26.4.275.s: yathāmnāyam̐ śālīkes trīm̐s tṛcān anubrūyād iti triḥ prathamām anūcya tisro 'nantarā anubrūyā ttri ruttamām |
26.4.275.d: यथाम्नायँ शालीकेस् त्रीँस् तृचान् अनुब्रूयाद् इति त्रिः प्रथमाम् अनूच्य तिस्रो ऽनन्तरा अनुब्रूया त्त्रि रुत्तमाम् ।
26.4.275.m: According to tradition, [the view] of Śālīki is: 'He should recite three triplets.' Having recited the first [verse] three times, he should recite three following verses, [and] three times the last.
[Regarding the rule:] 'He should recite fifteen'—we hand down by tradition these eleven kindling verses.

26.4.275.s: tāsāṃ triḥ prathamām anvāha trir uttamām | tāḥ pañcadaśa
26.4.275.d: तासां त्रिः प्रथमाम् अन्वाह त्रिर् उत्तमाम् । ताः पञ्चदश
26.4.275.m: Of them, he recites the first three times, the last three times: they are fifteen.

26.4.275.s: saptadaśānubrūyād ekavim̐śatim anubrūyāc caturvim̐śatim anubrūyāt trim̐śatam anubrūyād dvātrim̐śatam anubrūyāt ṣaṭtrim̐śatam anubrūyāc catvārim̐śatam anubrūyāc catuścatvārim̐śatam anubrūyād aṣṭācatvārim̐śatam anubrūyād iti dhāyyāloka etā dhātavyā bhavanti |
26.4.275.d: सप्तदशानुब्रूयाद् एकविँशतिम् अनुब्रूयाच् चतुर्विँशतिम् अनुब्रूयात् त्रिँशतम् अनुब्रूयाद् द्वात्रिँशतम् अनुब्रूयात् षट्त्रिँशतम् अनुब्रूयाच् चत्वारिँशतम् अनुब्रूयाच् चतुश्चत्वारिँशतम् अनुब्रूयाद् अष्टाचत्वारिँशतम् अनुब्रूयाद् इति धाय्यालोक एता धातव्या भवन्ति ।
26.4.275.m: [When the text says:] 'He should recite seventeen, he should recite twenty-one, he should recite twenty-four, he should recite thirty, he should recite thirty-two, he should recite thirty-six, he should recite forty, he should recite forty-four, he should recite forty-eight'—these are to be placed in the place of the insertional verses.

26.4.276.m: All are addressed to Agni and in the gāyatrī metre.

26.4.276.s: sarvāṇi chandām̐sy anubrūyād aparimitam anubrūyād iti dhāyyāloka evaitā dhātavyā bhavanti
26.4.276.d: सर्वाणि छन्दाँस्य् अनुब्रूयाद् अपरिमितम् अनुब्रूयाद् इति धाय्यालोक एवैता धातव्या भवन्ति
26.4.276.m: [When the text says:] 'He should recite all metres, he should recite an unlimited number'—these are to be placed precisely in the place of the insertional verses.
These are not all in the gāyatrī metre.

26.4.276.s: gāyatrī puro'nuvākyā bhavati triṣṭug yājyā purastāllakṣmā puro'nuvākyā bhavaty upariṣṭāllakṣmā yājyā
26.4.276.d: गायत्री पुरोऽनुवाक्या भवति त्रिष्टुग् याज्या पुरस्ताल्लक्ष्मा पुरोऽनुवाक्या भवत्य् उपरिष्टाल्लक्ष्मा याज्या
26.4.276.m: The invitatory verse is in the gāyatrī metre, the offering verse in the triṣṭubh metre. The invitatory verse has its characteristic mark at the beginning, the offering verse has its characteristic mark at the end.

26.4.276.s: mūrdhanvatī puro'nuvākyā bhavati niyutvatyā yajaty upām̐śuyājamantarā yajatīti
26.4.276.d: मूर्धन्वती पुरोऽनुवाक्या भवति नियुत्वत्या यजत्य् उपाँशुयाजमन्तरा यजतीति
26.4.276.m: [Regarding the rules:] 'The invitatory verse has a head, he sacrifices with [a verse] containing [the word] niyut, he sacrifices the silent sacrifice in between'—
this applies solely in the New and Full Moon rituals, nowhere else.

26.5.276.s: athemāḥ kāmyā iṣṭayo niṣpurīṣeṇaiva prayoktavyā bhavanti
26.5.276.d: अथेमाः काम्या इष्टयो निष्पुरीषेणैव प्रयोक्तव्या भवन्ति
26.5.276.m: Now, these optional sacrifices are to be performed strictly without loose earth.

26.5.276.s: sa saṃvatsaraṃ payovrataḥ syād dvādaśāhaṃ vā yāvad vā śam̐sīta
26.5.276.d: स संवत्सरं पयोव्रतः स्याद् द्वादशाहं वा यावद् वा शँसीत
26.5.276.m: He should subsist on milk for a year, or for twelve days, or as long as he might wish.

26.5.276.s: tāsāṃ yāḥ samānasaṃyojanā ekāṃ cet tāsāṃ nirvapet sarvā evaitā nirvaptavyā bhavanti yatho etad anāyukto 'gniparicaro 'lpam uddhṛtya punar apy uddharati
26.5.276.d: तासां याः समानसंयोजना एकां चेत् तासां निर्वपेत् सर्वा एवैता निर्वप्तव्या भवन्ति यथो एतद् अनायुक्तो ऽग्निपरिचरो ऽल्पम् उद्धृत्य पुनर् अप्य् उद्धरति
26.5.276.m: Among these, whichever have the same preparation, if he pours out [an oblation] for one of them, all of these are to be poured out; just as an unappointed servant of the fire, having taken out a small portion, takes it out again.

26.5.276.s: katham atra prāyaścittam̐ sidyatī3 na sidhyatī3 iti
26.5.276.d: कथम् अत्र प्रायश्चित्तँ सिद्यती३ न सिध्यती३ इति
26.5.276.m: "How does the expiation succeed here, or does it not succeed?"

26.5.276.s: sidhyatīty eka āhus | atha haika āhur na sidhyatīti
26.5.276.d: सिध्यतीत्य् एक आहुस् । अथ हैक आहुर् न सिध्यतीति
26.5.276.m: "It succeeds," say some; then some say, "It does not succeed."

26.5.276.s: nirdiṣṭabhāgo vā etayor anyo 'nirdiṣṭabhāgo 'nya iti | ubhāv u khalv imāv anirdiṣṭabhāgau bhavatas |
26.5.276.d: निर्दिष्टभागो वा एतयोर् अन्यो ऽनिर्दिष्टभागो ऽन्य इति । उभाव् उ खल्व् इमाव् अनिर्दिष्टभागौ भवतस् ।
26.5.276.m: "Indeed, one of these two has an assigned share, the other has an unassigned share." But both of these are [in fact] without an assigned share.
"It does not succeed at all." The taking of the shovel is the common ritual frame.

26.5.276.s: gārhapatyasakāśād dhṛṣṭim ādadīta tayāhavanīye vaiśvānarasya kapālāny upadadhyāt
26.5.276.d: गार्हपत्यसकाशाद् धृष्टिम् आददीत तयाहवनीये वैश्वानरस्य कपालान्य् उपदध्यात्
26.5.276.m: He should take the shovel from the vicinity of the gārhapatya fire. With it, he should place the potsherds for Vaiśvānara on the āhavanīya fire.

26.5.276.s: pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gārhapatye mārutasya kṛtāni piṣṭāni samupya saṃyutya vyabhimṛśya piṇḍau kṛtvāgreṇa mārutasya piṇḍaṃ paryāhṛtyāhavanīye vaiśvānaram adhipṛñjyāt
26.5.276.d: प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य गार्हपत्ये मारुतस्य कृतानि पिष्टानि समुप्य संयुत्य व्यभिमृश्य पिण्डौ कृत्वाग्रेण मारुतस्य पिण्डं पर्याहृत्याहवनीये वैश्वानरम् अधिपृञ्ज्यात्
26.5.276.m: Having turned around clockwise at the gārhapatya fire, having poured out the flour prepared for the Māruta [oblation], having mixed [it], having touched [it], having made two balls of dough, having brought [one] around in front of the dough for the Māruta [oblation], he should place the Vaiśvānara [dough] on [the potsherds] on the āhavanīya fire.

26.5.277.s: pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya gārhapatye mārutaṃ tvacaṃ grāhayitvemaṃ tvacaṃ grāhayet |
26.5.277.d: प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य गार्हपत्ये मारुतं त्वचं ग्राहयित्वेमं त्वचं ग्राहयेत् ।
26.5.277.m: Having turned around clockwise, having caused the Māruta [cake] to form a crust on the gārhapatya fire, he should cause this [other cake] to form a crust.

26.5.277.s: amuṃ paryagni kṛtvemaṃ paryagni kuryāt | amum̐ śrapayitvemam̐ śrapayet |
26.5.277.d: अमुं पर्यग्नि कृत्वेमं पर्यग्नि कुर्यात् । अमुँ श्रपयित्वेमँ श्रपयेत् ।
26.5.277.m: Having carried fire around that one, he should carry fire around this one. Having cooked that one, he should cook this one.

26.5.277.s: api vobhayam evobhayatra kuryāt tasya śṛtasyāsādanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim aparaṃ vimucya dakṣiṇaṃ vā paridhim agreṇa
26.5.277.d: अपि वोभयम् एवोभयत्र कुर्यात् तस्य शृतस्यासादनं दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम् अपरं विमुच्य दक्षिणं वा परिधिम् अग्रेण
26.5.277.m: Or else he may perform both [actions] at both [fires]. The setting down of it when cooked: having loosened the southern junction of the enclosing sticks towards the west, or in front of the southern enclosing stick.

26.5.277.s: etasmin vā etau mṛjāte yo vidviṣāṇayor annam atti | iti |
26.5.277.d: एतस्मिन् वा एतौ मृजाते यो विद्विषाणयोर् अन्नम् अत्ति । इति ।
26.5.277.m: "These two wipe themselves clean on him who eats the food of two who hate each other," so [it is said].

26.5.277.s: itaram itareṇety evaiṣa ukto bhavati yaṃ mṛdho 'bhi praveperan rāṣṭrāṇi vābhi samiyus | iti
26.5.277.d: इतरम् इतरेणेत्य् एवैष उक्तो भवति यं मृधो ऽभि प्रवेपेरन् राष्ट्राणि वाभि समियुस् । इति
26.5.277.m: By this, "one by means of the other" is indeed stated. "Against whom enemies might surge, or whom kingdoms might confront,"
the neighboring kings are the enemies.

26.5.277.s: sva eva janapadā rāṣṭrāṇi viśas | yo hatamanāḥ svayaṃpāpa iva syāt | iti
26.5.277.d: स्व एव जनपदा राष्ट्राणि विशस् । यो हतमनाः स्वयंपाप इव स्यात् । इति
26.5.277.m: His own settlements, kingdoms, and subjects [are meant]. "He who is broken-spirited, as if wicked himself,"

26.5.277.s: sati bale hatamanāḥ svayaṃpāpa iva syāditi
26.5.277.d: सति बले हतमनाः स्वयंपाप इव स्यादिति
26.5.277.m: means: even though strength is present, he is broken-spirited, as if wicked himself.

26.5.277.s: sādhurūpe kule svayaṃpāpas | yasmai prattam iva san na pradīyeta | iti
26.5.277.d: साधुरूपे कुले स्वयंपापस् । यस्मै प्रत्तम् इव सन् न प्रदीयेत । इति
26.5.277.m: "In a respectable family, being himself wicked." "To whom, though as if given, it is not given,"

26.5.278.s: prattam anupākṛtaṃ pratibadhyamānam evaitad bhavati | athāsyām adhvarakalpāyām iḍāntaṃ prathamaṃ tantraṃ kuryāt |
26.5.278.d: प्रत्तम् अनुपाकृतं प्रतिबध्यमानम् एवैतद् भवति । अथास्याम् अध्वरकल्पायाम् इडान्तं प्रथमं तन्त्रं कुर्यात् ।
26.5.278.m: means: given, yet not brought near, being obstructed indeed. Now, in this adhvarakalpā [sacrifice], he should make the first ritual procedure end with the iḍā.
He should perform the remainder together with the third [procedure].

26.5.278.s: katham atra bhakṣā iti tatratatra vā bhakṣayet | api vā sarvāsām̐ samavadāya hutvāntato bhakṣayet |
26.5.278.d: कथम् अत्र भक्षा इति तत्रतत्र वा भक्षयेत् । अपि वा सर्वासाँ समवदाय हुत्वान्ततो भक्षयेत् ।
26.5.278.m: "How are the consumptions [performed] here?" He may either consume [them] in each case, or having cut off from all of them, having offered, he may consume at the end.

26.5.278.s: yajamānasyaivaiṣa gauṣṭhād dātavyo bhavati vediṃ parigṛhyārdham uddhanyād ardhaṃ neti
26.5.278.d: यजमानस्यैवैष गौष्ठाद् दातव्यो भवति वेदिं परिगृह्यार्धम् उद्धन्याद् अर्धं नेति
26.5.278.m: This is to be given precisely from the sacrificer's pen. "Having measured out the altar, he should dig up half, not [the other] half,"

26.5.278.s: dakṣiṇaṃ vā veder ardham aparaṃ veti | aindrasyāvadāya vaiśvadevasyāvadyed athaindrasyopariṣṭād iti
26.5.278.d: दक्षिणं वा वेदेर् अर्धम् अपरं वेति । ऐन्द्रस्यावदाय वैश्वदेवस्यावद्येद् अथैन्द्रस्योपरिष्टाद् इति
26.5.278.m: either the southern half of the altar or the western [half]. "Having cut off [portions] of the Indra [oblation], he should cut off portions of the Viśve Devas oblation, then above that of the Indra [oblation],"
only two cuttings are thus stated.

26.5.278.s: upādhāyyapūrvayaṃ vāso dakṣiṇeti praveṇato vāntato vā tāmrāṇi vā nīlāni vā sūtrāṇy upahitāni bhavanti |
26.5.278.d: उपाधाय्यपूर्वयं वासो दक्षिणेति प्रवेणतो वान्ततो वा ताम्राणि वा नीलानि वा सूत्राण्य् उपहितानि भवन्ति ।
26.5.278.m: "A woven garment with an inserted warp is the sacrificial fee": copper-colored or blue threads are woven in from the start of the weaving or at the end.

26.5.278.s: api vopadhānarajjur evaiṣoktā bhavati | athāsyām̐ sajñāneṣṭyām̐ sakṛd evānuvācayet sakṛd āśrāvayet |
26.5.278.d: अपि वोपधानरज्जुर् एवैषोक्ता भवति । अथास्याँ सज्ञानेष्ट्याँ सकृद् एवानुवाचयेत् सकृद् आश्रावयेत् ।
26.5.278.m: Or rather, the cord of a pillow is what is spoken of. Now, in this sajñānī offering, he should have the [hotṛ priest] recite only once, he should make the call only once.
For it has two offering-and-introductory verses.

26.6.279.s: atha vai bhavati yadi nāvagacchet | imam aham ādityebhyo bhāgaṃ nirvapāmy āmuṣmād amuṣyai viśo 'vagantos | iti nirvapet | iti nirupyoparamati
26.6.279.d: अथ वै भवति यदि नावगच्छेत् । इमम् अहम् आदित्येभ्यो भागं निर्वपाम्य् आमुष्माद् अमुष्यै विशो ऽवगन्तोस् । इति निर्वपेत् । इति निरुप्योपरमति
26.6.279.m: Now indeed it happens: "If he does not succeed, he should pour out [an oblation] saying: 'I pour out this share for the Ādityas, so that such-and-such a person may be admitted into such-and-such a clan.'" Having poured it out, he pauses.

26.6.279.s: paridānāntaṃ karma kṛtvāthaitān vrīhīn kṛṣṇājine samupyottarārdhe 'gnyagārasyāsañjayet |
26.6.279.d: परिदानान्तं कर्म कृत्वाथैतान् व्रीहीन् कृष्णाजिने समुप्योत्तरार्धे ऽग्न्यगारस्यासञ्जयेत् ।
26.6.279.m: Having performed the rites ending with the dedicating [of the oblation], having gathered these grains of rice upon the black antelope skin, he should hang it up in the northern half of the fire-house.
Then, when he has been admitted, he should place it [upon the altar]. He should proceed with the rite beginning with the sprinkling.

26.6.279.s: siddham ata ūrdhvam | yathā nakhanirbhinnāyām evam̐ śatakṛṣṇalāyām |
26.6.279.d: सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् । यथा नखनिर्भिन्नायाम् एवँ शतकृष्णलायाम् ।
26.6.279.m: From here on it is established. As in the case of [the oblation] split with fingernails, so in the case of the one with a hundred kṛṣṇala berries.

26.6.279.s: purā vā taṇḍulānām āvapanād rukmam avadadhyāc chṛtam uttaram api vainam̐ śṛtam eva suvarṇarajatābhyām̐ rukmābhyāṃ parigṛhyāntarvedy āsādayet |
26.6.279.d: पुरा वा तण्डुलानाम् आवपनाद् रुक्मम् अवदध्याच् छृतम् उत्तरम् अपि वैनँ शृतम् एव सुवर्णरजताभ्याँ रुक्माभ्यां परिगृह्यान्तर्वेद्य् आसादयेत् ।
26.6.279.m: Or, before pouring in the cleaned rice grains, he should place a golden plate [underneath], and after it is cooked, another on top; or holding it, once cooked, with two plates, of gold and silver, he should set it down within the altar.

26.6.279.s: āgneyasya ca saumyasya caindre samāśleṣayed iti
26.6.279.d: आग्नेयस्य च सौम्यस्य चैन्द्रे समाश्लेषयेद् इति
26.6.279.m: "And he should blend [the oblations] for Agni and Soma into that for Indra."
Before placing them on [the fire], the touched dough-balls must be blended together.

26.6.279.s: sarveṣām abhigamayann avadyati | iti sadaivatasya sasviṣṭakṛttasyety evedam uktaṃ bhavati |
26.6.279.d: सर्वेषाम् अभिगमयन्न् अवद्यति । इति सदैवतस्य सस्विष्टकृत्तस्येत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति ।
26.6.279.m: "Bringing [the portions] into contact with all, he cuts off": this means [together with the portion] for the deity and together with that for Sviṣṭakṛt.

26.6.279.s: atho khalu yāvatīḥ samā eṣyan manyeta tāvan mānam̐ syād iti
26.6.279.d: अथो खलु यावतीः समा एष्यन् मन्येत तावन् मानँ स्याद् इति
26.6.279.m: Now, however many years he expects to live, so long should the measure be.
If he is thirty years old, he should make it a measure of seventy [cubits].

26.6.279.s: catvārim̐śadvarṣaś cet syāt ṣaṣṭimānaṃ kurvīta | eṣa evaitasyābhivṛddhikalpas |
26.6.279.d: चत्वारिँशद्वर्षश् चेत् स्यात् षष्टिमानं कुर्वीत । एष एवैतस्याभिवृद्धिकल्पस् ।
26.6.279.m: If he is forty years old, he should make it a measure of sixty [cubits]. / This alone is the rule for its increase.

26.6.280.s: atha vāruṇeṣu ca saṃjñāneṣṭyāṃ ca sakṛd evānuvācayet sakṛd āśrāvayet sakṛt pradānāḥ samānadevatās |
26.6.280.d: अथ वारुणेषु च संज्ञानेष्ट्यां च सकृद् एवानुवाचयेत् सकृद् आश्रावयेत् सकृत् प्रदानाः समानदेवतास् ।
26.6.280.m: Now, in the Varuṇa-offerings and in the Saṃjñāneṣṭi, he should cause [the hotṛ] to recite [the invitatory verse] only once, make the call only once; they have a single presentation, having the same deity.
"Having returned, he should offer the caru to Apāṃ Napāt."

26.6.280.s: ko nu khalv apāṃ napād bhavatīti vaidyuta ity eva brūyāt
26.6.280.d: को नु खल्व् अपां नपाद् भवतीति वैद्युत इत्य् एव ब्रूयात्
26.6.280.m: "Who indeed is Apāṃ Napāt?" / He should say: "The lightning [fire]."

26.6.280.s: kṛṣṇāmadhu ceti pauttikam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati | anastrigadham iti
26.6.280.d: कृष्णामधु चेति पौत्तिकम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति । अनस्त्रिगधम् इति
26.6.280.m: "And kṛṣṇāmadhu." / Honey from small bees is what is meant by this. / "Anastrigadham."

26.6.280.s: trivalīkam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati | athāpy udāharanti tricchadiṣkam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati
26.6.280.d: त्रिवलीकम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति त्रिच्छदिष्कम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
26.6.280.m: "Trivalīkam" is what is meant by this. / And they also quote: "Tricchadiṣkam" is what is meant by this.
As in the case of the tridhātu [offering], so is the procedure for portioning the disputed sacrificial cake.

26.7.280.s: sa sarpān asṛjata | iti māsā evaita uktā bhavanti sa vayām̐sy asṛjata | iti
26.7.280.d: स सर्पान् असृजत । इति मासा एवैत उक्ता भवन्ति स वयाँस्य् असृजत । इति
26.7.280.m: "He created the serpents": / the months indeed are meant by this. / "He created the birds":

26.7.280.s: chandām̐sy evaitāny uktāni bhavanti sa vaiva syād iti
26.7.280.d: छन्दाँस्य् एवैतान्य् उक्तानि भवन्ति स वैव स्याद् इति
26.7.280.m: the meters indeed are meant by this. / "It would be that very one."

26.7.280.s: purāṇagārhapatyam abhyupadiśanti tasya paśuvelāyām ulmukam ādāya dakṣiṇayā dvāropanirhṛtya dakṣiṇena sadaḥ parītya dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ paryāhṛtyāntareṇa yūpaṃ cāhavanīyaṃ copātihṛtyāntareṇa cātvālotkarāv udaṅṅ upanirhṛtya tena paśum̐ śrapayeyus |
26.7.280.d: पुराणगार्हपत्यम् अभ्युपदिशन्ति तस्य पशुवेलायाम् उल्मुकम् आदाय दक्षिणया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्य दक्षिणेन सदः परीत्य दक्षिणेन मार्जालीयं धिष्णियं पर्याहृत्यान्तरेण यूपं चाहवनीयं चोपातिहृत्यान्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उदङ्ङ् उपनिर्हृत्य तेन पशुँ श्रपयेयुस् ।
26.7.280.m: They indicate the old gārhapatya fire. Taking a firebrand from it at the time of the animal sacrifice, bringing it out by the southern door, going around to the south of the sadas, carrying it around to the south of the mārjālīya side-hearth, carrying it between the sacrificial post and the āhavanīya fire, and taking it out northwards between the pit and the rubbish-heap, they should cook the animal with it.

26.7.280.s: atha yad āhavanīyād ulmukam̐ syād vapayā tat sahāhareyuḥ
26.7.280.d: अथ यद् आहवनीयाद् उल्मुकँ स्याद् वपया तत् सहाहरेयुः
26.7.280.m: Now, whatever firebrand comes from the āhavanīya fire, they should bring that together with the omentum.

26.7.281.s: kiṃdevatyāni khalv apāvyāni bhavantīti dve prājāpatye āgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ vaiśvadevam iti |
26.7.281.d: किंदेवत्यानि खल्व् अपाव्यानि भवन्तीति द्वे प्राजापत्ये आग्नेयं वायव्यं वैश्वदेवम् इति ।
26.7.281.m: "To which deities do the apāvya [offerings] belong?" / Two belong to Prajāpati, one to Agni, one to Vāyu, one to the Viśvedevas.
"The adhvaryu priest is the iṣṭarga, the sacrificer's iṣṭarga."

26.7.281.s: uṣṇāgram ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati | athāpy udāharanty adhvaryur evaiṣa ukto bhavati |
26.7.281.d: उष्णाग्रम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्त्य् अध्वर्युर् एवैष उक्तो भवति ।
26.7.281.m: "Having a hot tip" is what is meant by this. / And they also quote: "The adhvaryu priest alone is meant by this."

26.7.281.s: āsanyān mā mantrāt pāhi kasyāś cid abhiśastyās | iti | anuvyāhāro ha vā āsanyo mantras
26.7.281.d: आसन्यान् मा मन्त्रात् पाहि कस्याश् चिद् अभिशस्त्यास् । इति । अनुव्याहारो ह वा आसन्यो मन्त्रस्
26.7.281.m: "Protect me from a spoken incantation, from any curse": / an imprecation indeed is a spoken mantra.

26.7.281.s: tasmān mā pāhīty evedam uktaṃ bhavati
26.7.281.d: तस्मान् मा पाहीत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
26.7.281.m: "Protect me from that" is what is meant by this.

26.7.281.s: tasmād yajñavāstu nābhyavetyam iti | ahorātrāv ity ekam | yāvad agnayaḥ śītāḥ syur ity etad ekam |
26.7.281.d: तस्माद् यज्ञवास्तु नाभ्यवेत्यम् इति । अहोरात्राव् इत्य् एकम् । यावद् अग्नयः शीताः स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
26.7.281.m: "Therefore the sacrificial ground should not be walked upon [until …]": / "[until] day and night [have passed]" is one [opinion]; "as long as the fires may be cold" is one [opinion];

26.7.281.s: yāvad enam abhivarṣed ity etad aparam |
26.7.281.d: यावद् एनम् अभिवर्षेद् इत्य् एतद् अपरम् ।
26.7.281.m: "until it rains upon it" is another [opinion].

26.7.281.s: dvau samudrau vitatāv ajūryau | iti | ahorātrāv evaitāv uktau bhavataḥ
26.7.281.d: द्वौ समुद्रौ वितताव् अजूर्यौ । इति । अहोरात्राव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतः
26.7.281.m: "Two unaging oceans are stretched out": / day and night indeed are meant by these two.
"They roll around like feet in the belly":

26.7.281.s: tayoḥ paśyanto atiyanty anyam apaśyantaḥ setunātiyanty anyam iti | ahaḥ paśyanto atiyanti rātrim | svapnena setunātiyanty anyam iti
26.7.281.d: तयोः पश्यन्तो अतियन्त्य् अन्यम् अपश्यन्तः सेतुनातियन्त्य् अन्यम् इति । अहः पश्यन्तो अतियन्ति रात्रिम् । स्वप्नेन सेतुनातियन्त्य् अन्यम् इति
26.7.281.m: "Seeing, they cross over one of the two; not seeing, they cross over the other with a bridge": / "Seeing, they cross over the day; not seeing, they cross over the other, the night, with the bridge of sleep."

26.7.281.s: dve dradhasī satatī vasta ekas | iti | ādityo 'horātre vasta ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati
26.7.281.d: द्वे द्रधसी सतती वस्त एकस् । इति । आदित्यो ऽहोरात्रे वस्त इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
26.7.281.m: "One wears two continuous cloaks": / "The sun wears day and night" is what is meant by this.

26.7.281.s: tirodhāyaity asitaṃ vasānaḥ śukram ādatte anuhāya jāryai | iti
26.7.281.d: तिरोधायैत्य् असितं वसानः शुक्रम् आदत्ते अनुहाय जार्यै । इति
26.7.281.m: "Hiding away, he goes dressing in black; leaving behind the bright, he takes it for the lover":

26.7.281.s: rātriṃ vasānas tirodhāyaiti śukram ādatte 'har ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati
26.7.281.d: रात्रिं वसानस् तिरोधायैति शुक्रम् आदत्ते ऽहर् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
26.7.281.m: "Dressing in night, he goes hiding away; he takes the bright, the day" is what is meant by this.

26.7.281.s: kīṭāvapannasyeti katamo nu khalv ayaṃ kīṭo bhavati
26.7.281.d: कीटावपन्नस्येति कतमो नु खल्व् अयं कीटो भवति
26.7.281.m: "Of that into which an insect has fallen": / what kind of insect is this indeed?

26.7.281.s: ya evaiṣa piṇḍān saṃvartayatīti nitye grahaṇe vaiṣṇavīm ṛcam anuvartayatīti
26.7.281.d: य एवैष पिण्डान् संवर्तयतीति नित्ये ग्रहणे वैष्णवीम् ऋचम् अनुवर्तयतीति
26.7.281.m: "That which rolls dung-balls": / "In the daily drawing, he applies a verse to Viṣṇu":

26.7.282.m: it is to the speckled butter that this should be applied.

26.8.282.s: athāto 'tigrāhyān vyākhyāsyāmas | ime nv eva pṛṣṭhyātigrāhyāḥ pañcaindrā vājapeye
26.8.282.d: अथातो ऽतिग्राह्यान् व्याख्यास्यामस् । इमे न्व् एव पृष्ठ्यातिग्राह्याः पञ्चैन्द्रा वाजपेये
26.8.282.m: Now then, we shall explain the supplementary cups. These are the supplementary cups of the pṛṣṭhya [ṣaḍaha]: five to Indra at the Vājapeya,
the paraḥsāman and arvāksāman [cups], and one to Sūrya at the Viṣuvant,
two to Viśvakarman and the Ādityas at the Gavāmayana, one to Prajāpati at the Mahāvrata,

26.8.282.s: bārhaspatyo bṛhaspatisave vaimṛdhe codbhidi ca tviṣim ati ca vṛṣā so am̐śuḥ pavata iti ca
26.8.282.d: बार्हस्पत्यो बृहस्पतिसवे वैमृधे चोद्भिदि च त्विषिम् अति च वृषा सो अँशुः पवत इति च
26.8.282.m: one to Bṛhaspati at the Bṛhaspatisava, and at the Vaimṛdha and the Udbhid with [the verses]: "tviṣim ati" and "vṛṣā so am̐śuḥ pavate",

26.8.282.s: dvāv aśvamedhe mahimānau | ādeśād evāśvasya vapāṃ mahimābhyāṃ parijuhuyāt
26.8.282.d: द्वाव् अश्वमेधे महिमानौ । आदेशाद् एवाश्वस्य वपां महिमाभ्यां परिजुहुयात्
26.8.282.m: two Mahimān cups at the Aśvamedha. By an express rule, he should offer around the horse's omentum with the two Mahimān cups.

26.8.282.s: katham u khalu paraḥsāsnāṃ bhakṣo bhavatīti
26.8.282.d: कथम् उ खलु परःसास्नां भक्षो भवतीति
26.8.282.m: "And how is the consuming of the paraḥsāman [cups]?"

26.8.282.s: rudravadgaṇasya soma deva te mativido mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya triṣṭupchandaso 'dbhir oṣadhībhiḥ pītasyauṣadhībhiḥ prajābhiḥ pītasya prajābhiḥ prajāpatinā pītasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi | iti |
26.8.282.d: रुद्रवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदो माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसो ऽद्भिर् ओषधीभिः पीतस्यौषधीभिः प्रजाभिः पीतस्य प्रजाभिः प्रजापतिना पीतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि । इति ।
26.8.282.m: "With the troop of the Rudras, O divine Soma, being invited, I consume thee, the mind-knower, of the midday pressing, of the triṣṭubh meter, drunk by the waters, by the plants, drunk by the plants, by the creatures, drunk by the creatures, by Prajāpati, honey-rich."—
this same is the reversed consumption for the arvāksāman [cups].

26.8.282.s: aṣṭāprūḍ ḍhiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇeti | aṣṭāpilakam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati
26.8.282.d: अष्टाप्रूड् ढिरण्यं दक्षिणेति । अष्टापिलकम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
26.8.282.m: "Gold of eight aprūṭs is the priestly fee": / "Of eight apilakas" is what is meant by this.

26.8.282.s: dvau ced garbhau syātāṃ dvādaśaprūṭ syāt | eko ha mahākośaḥ syād dvāv avāntarakośau syātām
26.8.282.d: द्वौ चेद् गर्भौ स्यातां द्वादशप्रूट् स्यात् । एको ह महाकोशः स्याद् द्वाव् अवान्तरकोशौ स्याताम्
26.8.282.m: If there should be two embryos, it should be of twelve prūṭs. There should be one large sheath, and two intermediate sheaths.

26.8.283.s: athāsthigarbhāyā ājyenaivaitāny asthāni samudāyutya madhyamena parṇenāntaḥparidhi ninayet | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti ||
26.8.283.d: अथास्थिगर्भाया आज्येनैवैतान्य् अस्थानि समुदायुत्य मध्यमेन पर्णेनान्तःपरिधि निनयेत् । भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति ॥
26.8.283.m: Now, in the case of [a cow] with bones in her womb, having mixed these bones with clarified butter, he should pour them inside the enclosing sticks with a middle leaf, saying, "Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar."

26.9.283.s: yad ālabdhāyām abhro bhavatīti | ālabdhāyāṃ ced abhraḥ syāt sam̐sthāpayed eva |
26.9.283.d: यद् आलब्धायाम् अभ्रो भवतीति । आलब्धायां चेद् अभ्रः स्यात् सँस्थापयेद् एव ।
26.9.283.m: "When there are clouds when [the animal] is seized": if there should be clouds when it is seized, he should just complete [the sacrifice].

26.9.283.s: atha ced upākṛtāyām abhraḥ syād anyam etasmin sthāna upākṛtyottaram ameghasaṃpannam etayāgamyerann iti |
26.9.283.d: अथ चेद् उपाकृतायाम् अभ्रः स्याद् अन्यम् एतस्मिन् स्थान उपाकृत्योत्तरम् अमेघसंपन्नम् एतयागम्येरन्न् इति ।
26.9.283.m: Now, if there should be clouds when it is dedicated, having dedicated another in its place, they should wait with this one for a cloudless later [occasion].

26.9.283.s: atheme jayā abhyātānā rāṣṭrabhṛta ity āhitāgneś cānāhitāgneś cānyatra vihārād dṛṣṭā bhavanti |
26.9.283.d: अथेमे जया अभ्याताना राष्ट्रभृत इत्य् आहिताग्नेश् चानाहिताग्नेश् चान्यत्र विहाराद् दृष्टा भवन्ति ।
26.9.283.m: Now, these Jaya, Abhyātāna, and Rāṣṭrabhṛt [offerings] are seen for both one who has set up the sacred fires and one who has not, outside the ritual enclosure.

26.9.283.s: abhisamārambhāt tv evainān ācāryāḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛta upajuhvati | aṣṭau vasava iti
26.9.283.d: अभिसमारम्भात् त्व् एवैनान् आचार्याः प्राक् स्विष्टकृत उपजुह्वति । अष्टौ वसव इति
26.9.283.m: However, because of the initial undertaking, the teachers offer them as secondary offerings before the sviṣṭakṛt. / "Eight Vasus":

26.9.283.s: katame nu khalv ime vasavo bhavantīti pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ dyaur agnir vāyur ādityaś candramā āpa ity ete 'ṣṭau vasavas |
26.9.283.d: कतमे नु खल्व् इमे वसवो भवन्तीति पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षं द्यौर् अग्निर् वायुर् आदित्यश् चन्द्रमा आप इत्य् एते ऽष्टौ वसवस् ।
26.9.283.m: which Vasus are these indeed? Earth, intermediate space, heaven, fire, wind, sun, moon, and waters—these are the eight Vasus.

26.9.283.s: eteṣu vā idam̐ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yad idaṃ kiṃ ca ya evaṃ veda praty eva tiṣṭhati |
26.9.283.d: एतेषु वा इदँ सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितं यद् इदं किं च य एवं वेद प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति ।
26.9.283.m: On them, truly, all this is established, whatever exists here. He who knows thus becomes firmly established.

26.9.283.s: ekādaśa rudrā iti prāṇā evaita uktā bhavanti
26.9.283.d: एकादश रुद्रा इति प्राणा एवैत उक्ता भवन्ति
26.9.283.m: "Eleven Rudras": / the vital breaths indeed are meant by these.

26.9.283.s: dvādaśādityā iti māsā evaita uktā bhavanti pañca gṛhyante navanava gṛhyante pañcadhā vigṛhyante
26.9.283.d: द्वादशादित्या इति मासा एवैत उक्ता भवन्ति पञ्च गृह्यन्ते नवनव गृह्यन्ते पञ्चधा विगृह्यन्ते
26.9.283.m: "Twelve Ādityas": / the months indeed are meant by these. Five are drawn, nine each are drawn, they are divided into five parts.

26.9.284.s: atha ya eva daśamo mantra eteṣām evaiṣo 'bhigrahaṇārtho dṛṣṭo bhavati
26.9.284.d: अथ य एव दशमो मन्त्र एतेषाम् एवैषो ऽभिग्रहणार्थो दृष्टो भवति
26.9.284.m: Now, the tenth mantra among these is seen as intended for taking hold of them.

26.9.284.s: tāṃ dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyād yasyānnaṃ nādyād iti
26.9.284.d: तां दुग्ध्वा ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद् यस्यान्नं नाद्याद् इति
26.9.284.m: "Having milked her, he should give her to a brāhmaṇa whose food he would not eat."

26.9.284.s: bhaikṣāya pratyavasthitāyaivaiṣā dātavyā bhavati kiṃdevatyā u khalv atiriktasomā bhavantīti
26.9.284.d: भैक्षाय प्रत्यवस्थितायैवैषा दातव्या भवति किंदेवत्या उ खल्व् अतिरिक्तसोमा भवन्तीति
26.9.284.m: She is to be given only to one who has devoted himself to begging. / "And to which deities do the surplus soma-libations belong?"

26.9.284.s: yaṃyaṃ graham abhyatiricyeram̐s tattaddevatyā eva syur ity etad ekam
26.9.284.d: यंयं ग्रहम् अभ्यतिरिच्येरँस् तत्तद्देवत्या एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम्
26.9.284.m: "Whichever cup they were left over from, they should belong to that same deity"—this is one [opinion].

26.9.284.s: athāparam | vijñāyata u khalv eṣāṃ brāhmaṇam atha kasmād aindro yajña ā sam̐sthātos | ity etasmād aindrāvaiṣṇavā eva bhavanti
26.9.284.d: अथापरम् । विज्ञायत उ खल्व् एषां ब्राह्मणम् अथ कस्माद् ऐन्द्रो यज्ञ आ सँस्थातोस् । इत्य् एतस्माद् ऐन्द्रावैष्णवा एव भवन्ति
26.9.284.m: Now the other: indeed, their brāhmaṇa passage is known: "Now why is the sacrifice sacred to Indra until the conclusion?"—on account of this, they belong to Indra and Viṣṇu alone.
"Cooling down with it, they should await the completion of the six-day rite."

26.9.284.s: ṣaḍahabrāhmaṇam evaitad bhavati | atha ced ahaḥsaṃyoga evam āpadyeta yathāpi nava madhyamāni sāṃvatsarikāṇy ahāni saṃnigaccheyus tadānīm evainam̐ śītīkṛtvā saṃcinuyus |
26.9.284.d: षडहब्राह्मणम् एवैतद् भवति । अथ चेद् अहःसंयोग एवम् आपद्येत यथापि नव मध्यमानि सांवत्सरिकाण्य् अहानि संनिगच्छेयुस् तदानीम् एवैनँ शीतीकृत्वा संचिनुयुस् ।
26.9.284.m: This is a brāhmaṇa passage on the six-day rite. Now if an alignment of days should occur in this way, such that nine middle days of the yearly rite should coincide, having cooled it at that very moment, they should pile it.

26.9.284.d: अथ चेद् उदयनीये ऽतिरात्र एतद् एव
26.9.284.m: Now, if at the concluding atirātra, the same thing [applies].

26.9.284.s: prajā vai sattram āsata tapas tapyamānā ajuhvatīs | iti
26.9.284.d: प्रजा वै सत्त्रम् आसत तपस् तप्यमाना अजुह्वतीस् । इति
26.9.284.m: "The creatures indeed sat at a sacrificial session, performing asceticism, not offering,"

26.9.284.s: tat pṛcchanti katamat tat sattraṃ bhavatīti yad evaitad anāhitāgnayo vṛthāśramam̐ śrāmyanty etat sattraṃ bhavatīti ||
26.9.284.d: तत् पृच्छन्ति कतमत् तत् सत्त्रं भवतीति यद् एवैतद् अनाहिताग्नयो वृथाश्रमँ श्राम्यन्त्य् एतत् सत्त्रं भवतीति ॥
26.9.284.m: in regard to that they ask: which sacrificial session is that? That which men who have not set up the sacred fires perform as fruitless toil, that is this sacrificial session.

26.10.285.s: āśvinaṃ prāg āśvinam iti kiyan nu khalv āśvinaṃ bhavatīti
26.10.285.d: आश्विनं प्राग् आश्विनम् इति कियन् नु खल्व् आश्विनं भवतीति
26.10.285.m: "The distance of a horse-journey eastwards." How great indeed is a horse-journey?

26.10.285.s: dviyojanaṃ vā yāvadvāśvo 'hnā gacchet | dvistāvā vedir bhavatīti |
26.10.285.d: द्वियोजनं वा यावद्वाश्वो ऽह्ना गच्छेत् । द्विस्तावा वेदिर् भवतीति ।
26.10.285.m: Either two yojanas, or as far as a horse might go in a day. "The altar is twice as large."
He should take the diagonal measurement of a square formed by the step used for the fire altar.

26.10.285.s: sa prakramaḥ syāt tena vediṃ vimimīta | api vā vim̐śatyāś ca rathākṣāṇām ekavim̐śatyāś ca padānām aṣṭāṅgulasya ca caturvim̐śaṃ bhāgam ādadīta
26.10.285.d: स प्रक्रमः स्यात् तेन वेदिं विमिमीत । अपि वा विँशत्याश् च रथाक्षाणाम् एकविँशत्याश् च पदानाम् अष्टाङ्गुलस्य च चतुर्विँशं भागम् आददीत
26.10.285.m: That would be a step. With that he should measure out the altar. Or, he should take a twenty-fourth part of twenty chariot-axles, twenty-one foot-lengths, and eight finger-breadths.

26.10.285.s: sa prakramaḥ syāt tena vediṃ vimimīte
26.10.285.d: स प्रक्रमः स्यात् तेन वेदिं विमिमीते
26.10.285.m: That would be a step. With that he measures out the altar.

26.10.285.s: tristāvo 'gnir bhavatīti tryaḥ trayaḥ saptavidhāḥ sa ekavim̐śatividhas |
26.10.285.d: त्रिस्तावो ऽग्निर् भवतीति त्र्यः त्रयः सप्तविधाः स एकविँशतिविधस् ।
26.10.285.m: "The fire altar is thrice as large": three sevenfold [altars]; that is a twenty-one-fold [altar].

26.10.285.s: athaitau hradau madhyato devayajanasya joṣayata iti
26.10.285.d: अथैतौ ह्रदौ मध्यतो देवयजनस्य जोषयत इति
26.10.285.m: "Then they locate these two pools in the middle of the place of sacrifice."

26.10.285.s: kimarthau khalv imau hradau bhavata iti | aśvaplāvano ha dakṣiṇa āvabhṛthika uttaras |
26.10.285.d: किमर्थौ खल्व् इमौ ह्रदौ भवत इति । अश्वप्लावनो ह दक्षिण आवभृथिक उत्तरस् ।
26.10.285.m: For what purpose are these two pools? The southern one is for bathing the horse; the northern is for the purificatory bath.

26.10.285.s: dvau dāsāv anujāyai ca putro 'nvādheyāyai ceti
26.10.285.d: द्वौ दासाव् अनुजायै च पुत्रो ऽन्वाधेयायै चेति
26.10.285.m: "Two slaves: the son of a younger sister and of an inherited maidservant."

26.10.285.s: yo 'sya pitur anujāyāḥ putraḥ sa purastān nayaty atha yo 'sya mātur anvādheyāyai putraḥ so 'paras |
26.10.285.d: यो ऽस्य पितुर् अनुजायाः पुत्रः स पुरस्तान् नयत्य् अथ यो ऽस्य मातुर् अन्वाधेयायै पुत्रः सो ऽपरस् ।
26.10.285.m: He who is the son of his father's younger sister leads from the front; and he who is the son of his mother's inherited maidservant is the other.
"Having bound around the left knee with an old worn rope,"

26.10.285.s: upadhānarajjur evaiṣoktā bhavati śataṃ vai talpyā rājaputrā iti
26.10.285.d: उपधानरज्जुर् एवैषोक्ता भवति शतं वै तल्प्या राजपुत्रा इति
26.10.285.m: the cord of a pillow is what is spoken of. "A hundred princes eligible for royal seats,"

26.10.286.s: pratihitā evaita uktā bhavanti śatam̐ rājāna ugrā iti
26.10.286.d: प्रतिहिता एवैत उक्ता भवन्ति शतँ राजान उग्रा इति
26.10.286.m: these are stated to be the designated successors. "A hundred fierce rajanyas,"

26.10.286.s: rājanyā evaite nābhiṣecyā bhavanti | atha sāvitram aṣṭākapālaṃ prātar nirvapatīti |
26.10.286.d: राजन्या एवैते नाभिषेच्या भवन्ति । अथ सावित्रम् अष्टाकपालं प्रातर् निर्वपतीति ।
26.10.286.m: these are rājanyas not to be anointed. "Then in the morning he pours out [an oblation] on eight potsherds for Savitar."
This is the first Sāvitrī offering.

26.10.286.s: vaiśvadevaparuṣi dvitīyā | aparāhṇe tṛtīyā | etad atraikāhikaṃ karma jānīyāt |
26.10.286.d: वैश्वदेवपरुषि द्वितीया । अपराह्णे तृतीया । एतद् अत्रैकाहिकं कर्म जानीयात् ।
26.10.286.m: The second is in the Viśve Devas section. The third is in the afternoon. One should know this to be the rite belonging to a single day here.

26.10.286.s: uttarataś ca devayajanād udavasyec cāturmāsikānāṃ paśūnām evaṃ vāyavyāya paśava evaṃ tūparāya
26.10.286.d: उत्तरतश् च देवयजनाद् उदवस्येच् चातुर्मासिकानां पशूनाम् एवं वायव्याय पशव एवं तूपराय
26.10.286.m: And he should conclude north of the sacrificial grounds; of the seasonal animals, thus for the animals sacred to Vāyu, thus for the hornless one.
"He sacrifices with this offering for seven days."

26.10.286.s: katham atra bhakṣā iti tatratatra vā bhakṣayed api vā purastād evaitasmai saptāhāya
26.10.286.d: कथम् अत्र भक्षा इति तत्रतत्र वा भक्षयेद् अपि वा पुरस्ताद् एवैतस्मै सप्ताहाय
26.10.286.m: "How are the consumptions [performed] here?" He may either consume [them] in each case, or beforehand indeed for this seven-day period.
"Having recited the sacrificial post, he fixes the post made of rajjudāla wood opposite the fire."

26.10.286.s: śleṣmātaka ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati athāpy udāharanti rājjudālam agniṣṭhaṃ minoti bhrūṇahatyāyā apahatyai
26.10.286.d: श्लेष्मातक इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति राज्जुदालम् अग्निष्ठं मिनोति भ्रूणहत्याया अपहत्यै
26.10.286.m: This means a śleṣmātaka tree. Now they also quote: "He fixes the post made of rajjudāla wood opposite the fire to ward off the destruction of an embryo."

26.10.286.s: pautudravāv abhito bhavataḥ puṇyasya gandhasyāvaruddhyā iti
26.10.286.d: पौतुद्रवाव् अभितो भवतः पुण्यस्य गन्धस्यावरुद्ध्या इति
26.10.286.m: "Two [posts] are made of pūtudru wood on both sides to win holy fragrance."
"He gives a third of the sacrificial fees [dakṣiṇās]."

26.10.286.s: āgnikānām u ha tṛtīyaṃ kāmapreṇa saha tṛtīyam atirātre tṛtīyam |
26.10.286.d: आग्निकानाम् उ ह तृतीयं कामप्रेण सह तृतीयम् अतिरात्रे तृतीयम् ।
26.10.286.m: Indeed, a third of those related to the fire[-building] together with the desire-fulfilling [gift], a third at the atirātra, [and] a third [thereafter].

26.10.286.s: catuṣṭoma eṣa bhavati caturutrarīya eṣa catuṣṭomo bhavati ||
26.10.286.d: चतुष्टोम एष भवति चतुरुत्ररीय एष चतुष्टोमो भवति ॥
26.10.286.m: This is a catuṣṭoma; this catuṣṭoma has an increase of four each time.

26.11.287.s: ekasmai svāhā dvābhyām̐ svāhā | iti katham u khalv etān anuvākāñ juhuyād iti
26.11.287.d: एकस्मै स्वाहा द्वाभ्याँ स्वाहा । इति कथम् उ खल्व् एतान् अनुवाकाञ् जुहुयाद् इति
26.11.287.m: Regarding: "To one, hail! To two, hail!" [it is asked]: "How indeed should he offer these anuvākas?"

26.11.287.s: yathāprakṛtyas tathānantarāyam̐ hotavyās | caturvim̐śatim̐ raśanā ādāya yūpānabhyāyanti catasraścatasra itare parikarmiṇa iti
26.11.287.d: यथाप्रकृत्यस् तथानन्तरायँ होतव्यास् । चतुर्विँशतिँ रशना आदाय यूपानभ्यायन्ति चतस्रश्चतस्र इतरे परिकर्मिण इति
26.11.287.m: "As they are in the basic form, thus they should be offered without interruption. Taking twenty-four ropes, they approach the sacrificial posts, the other attendants four each."

26.11.287.s: katham etāsu niyuñjyād iti | aśvas tūparo gomṛgas | iti te trayaḥsamānaraśanās |
26.11.287.d: कथम् एतासु नियुञ्ज्याद् इति । अश्वस् तूपरो गोमृगस् । इति ते त्रयःसमानरशनास् ।
26.11.287.m: "How should he bind [the animals] to these?" "A horse, a hornless [goat], and a gomṛga"—these three share a common rope.
Three on the forehead-parts, five on the side-girths.

26.11.287.s: agnaye 'nīkavate rohitāñjir anaḍvān ity eteṣv aṣṭau
26.11.287.d: अग्नये ऽनीकवते रोहिताञ्जिर् अनड्वान् इत्य् एतेष्व् अष्टौ
26.11.287.m: In [the section beginning]: "To Agni with the vanguard, a reddish-marked ox," eight [animals].

26.11.287.s: somāya svarājñe 'novāhāv anaḍvāhau | ity eteṣu sapta | athaiteṣāṃ trayastrayaḥ samānaraśanās |
26.11.287.d: सोमाय स्वराज्ञे ऽनोवाहाव् अनड्वाहौ । इत्य् एतेषु सप्त । अथैतेषां त्रयस्त्रयः समानरशनास् ।
26.11.287.m: In [the section beginning]: "To Soma the independent ruler, two cart-drawing oxen," seven [animals]. Now, these three and three share a common rope.

26.11.287.s: mukhyasyaivaiṣāṃ caturthī bhavati samānaṃ karmā paryagnikaraṇāt
26.11.287.d: मुख्यस्यैवैषां चतुर्थी भवति समानं कर्मा पर्यग्निकरणात्
26.11.287.m: The fourth [rope] belongs only to the principal of them. The ritual is the same up to the carrying of fire around [the victims].

26.11.287.s: paryagnikṛtānām eteṣāṃ paśūnām ūnavim̐śatir utsṛjyanta ekacatvārim̐śatam atiśiṣyante
26.11.287.d: पर्यग्निकृतानाम् एतेषां पशूनाम् ऊनविँशतिर् उत्सृज्यन्त एकचत्वारिँशतम् अतिशिष्यन्ते
26.11.287.m: Of these animals around which fire has been carried, nineteen are released, [and] forty-one remain.

26.11.287.s: dvicatvārim̐śatam eṣām̐ śāsā bhavanty aśve 'tra dvau samāsaṃ gacchatas |
26.11.287.d: द्विचत्वारिँशतम् एषाँ शासा भवन्त्य् अश्वे ऽत्र द्वौ समासं गच्छतस् ।
26.11.287.m: Their slaughtering knives are forty-two; in the case of the horse, two combine here.

26.11.287.s: athetareṣāṃ pratipaśu saṃpadyante | indrāgnibhyām ojodābhyām uṣṭārau | iti
26.11.287.d: अथेतरेषां प्रतिपशु संपद्यन्ते । इन्द्राग्निभ्याम् ओजोदाभ्याम् उष्टारौ । इति
26.11.287.m: Then, for the others, they correspond animal by animal. "To Indra and Agni, granters of vigor, two camels."

26.11.287.s: prāsaṅgyāv evaitāv uktau bhavatas | athaitasmiñ chalmaliśarca āśupiṣṭāni saṃyutyeti |
26.11.287.d: प्रासङ्ग्याव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतस् । अथैतस्मिञ् छल्मलिशर्च आशुपिष्टानि संयुत्येति ।
26.11.287.m: These two are said to be yoked together as a pair. "Then, having mixed fast-growing [rice] flour in this śālmali vessel—"

26.11.288.s: āśukānām evaitāni vrīhīṇāṃ piṣṭāni śalmaliśleṣmaṇā saṃyutāni bhavanti
26.11.288.d: आशुकानाम् एवैतानि व्रीहीणां पिष्टानि शल्मलिश्लेष्मणा संयुतानि भवन्ति
26.11.288.m: this flour is made of fast-growing rice, mixed with the gum of the śālmali tree.
The pratiprasthātṛ priests cut off the portions separately.

26.11.288.s: teṣāṃ maitrāvaruṇā evānubrūyus | catvāry evaitāni pradānāni bhavanti |
26.11.288.d: तेषां मैत्रावरुणा एवानुब्रूयुस् । चत्वार्य् एवैतानि प्रदानानि भवन्ति ।
26.11.288.m: Their maitrāvaruṇa priests should recite the puronuvākyās. These offerings are just four.

26.11.288.s: iluvardāya svāhā balivardāya svāhā | iti sūryācandramasāv evaitāv uktau bhavatas |
26.11.288.d: इलुवर्दाय स्वाहा बलिवर्दाय स्वाहा । इति सूर्याचन्द्रमसाव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतस् ।
26.11.288.m: "To Iluvarda, hail! To Balivarda, hail!"—these two are declared to be the sun and the moon.

26.11.288.s: athāpy udāharanti saṃvatsaro vā iluvardaḥ parivatsaro balivardas | iti
26.11.288.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति संवत्सरो वा इलुवर्दः परिवत्सरो बलिवर्दस् । इति
26.11.288.m: Moreover, they cite: "The year is Iluvarda; the parivatsara is Balivarda."

26.11.288.s: tasya mūrdhni juhoti jumbakāya svāhā | iti
26.11.288.d: तस्य मूर्ध्नि जुहोति जुम्बकाय स्वाहा । इति
26.11.288.m: Upon his head he offers: "To Jumbaka, hail!"

26.11.288.s: kiṃdevatyā u khalv iyam āhutir bhavatīti vāruṇītyeva brūyāt
26.11.288.d: किंदेवत्या उ खल्व् इयम् आहुतिर् भवतीति वारुणीत्येव ब्रूयात्
26.11.288.m: "To which deity does this oblation belong?" He should say: "It belongs to Varuṇa."

26.11.288.s: kikidīvir vidīgaya iti vididihīvikīdīha kikidīvir bhavati
26.11.288.d: किकिदीविर् विदीगय इति विदिदिहीविकीदीह किकिदीविर् भवति
26.11.288.m: "A kikidīvi, a vidīgaya"—the kikidīvi is a blue jay [vididihīvikīdīha].

26.11.288.s: pṛṣata ua pataṃgo vidīgayas | athaitān paśūn upākaroty āgneyam aindrāgnam āśvinam iti
26.11.288.d: पृषत उअ पतंगो विदीगयस् । अथैतान् पशून् उपाकरोत्य् आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् आश्विनम् इति
26.11.288.m: The vidīgaya is a spotted flying bird. Then he dedicates these animals: one to Agni, one to Indra and Agni, and one to the Aśvins.
These goats are twins, born from the same womb.
Their procedure has been stated, just like that of the eleven animals [ekādaśinī].

26.11.288.s: kiṃdevatyā u khalv ṛtupaśavo bhavantīti | ṛtudevatā ity etad ekam
26.11.288.d: किंदेवत्या उ खल्व् ऋतुपशवो भवन्तीति । ऋतुदेवता इत्य् एतद् एकम्
26.11.288.m: "To which deities do the season-animals [ṛtupaśus] belong?" "Their deities are the seasons"—this is one view.

26.11.288.s: athāparam āgneyāḥ prathamā aindrā dvitīyā vaiśvadevās tṛtīyā maitrāvaruṇāś caturthā bārhaspatyāḥ pañcamāḥ sāvitrāḥ ṣaṣṭhāḥ saṃvatsarāya nivakṣasa iti prājāpatyāḥ ||
26.11.288.d: अथापरम् आग्नेयाः प्रथमा ऐन्द्रा द्वितीया वैश्वदेवास् तृतीया मैत्रावरुणाश् चतुर्था बार्हस्पत्याः पञ्चमाः सावित्राः षष्ठाः संवत्सराय निवक्षस इति प्राजापत्याः ॥
26.11.288.m: Now the other: The first belong to Agni; the second to Indra; the third to the Viśve Devas; the fourth to Mitra and Varuṇa; the fifth to Bṛhaspati; the sixth to Savitar; [and the ones dedicated] "to the year with its breast" belong to Prajāpati.

26.12.289.s: athāyaṃ dvādaśāha ubhayavidho bhavaty ahīno vā sattraṃ vā
26.12.289.d: अथायं द्वादशाह उभयविधो भवत्य् अहीनो वा सत्त्रं वा
26.12.289.m: Now, this twelve-day rite is of two kinds: either an ahīna or a sattra.

26.12.289.s: sa yady u haiko dīkṣate 'hīno bhavati | atha yadi bahavaḥ sattram |
26.12.289.d: स यद्य् उ हैको दीक्षते ऽहीनो भवति । अथ यदि बहवः सत्त्रम् ।
26.12.289.m: If one person undergoes consecration [dīkṣā], it is an ahīna; if many, it is a sattra.

26.12.289.s: yadi caivāhīno yadi ca sattram ubhayathaivobhayato'tirātro bhavati |
26.12.289.d: यदि चैवाहीनो यदि च सत्त्रम् उभयथैवोभयतोऽतिरात्रो भवति ।
26.12.289.m: Whether it is an ahīna or a sattra, in both cases it has an atirātra on both ends.

26.12.289.s: anyatarato 'tirātrā hy ahīnā bhavanty ubhayato'tirātrāṇi sattrāṇi |
26.12.289.d: अन्यतरतो ऽतिरात्रा ह्य् अहीना भवन्त्य् उभयतोऽतिरात्राणि सत्त्राणि ।
26.12.289.m: For ahīnas have an atirātra at one end, while sattras have atirātras at both ends.

26.12.289.s: ādeśād evobhayato'tirātro 'hīno bhavaty ādeśāt tu sattram anatirātraṃ yathaitad agniṣṭomāyanam̐ sārasvatam ayanaṃ viśvasṛjāmayanam iti
26.12.289.d: आदेशाद् एवोभयतोऽतिरात्रो ऽहीनो भवत्य् आदेशात् तु सत्त्रम् अनतिरात्रं यथैतद् अग्निष्टोमायनँ सारस्वतम् अयनं विश्वसृजामयनम् इति
26.12.289.m: Only by explicit prescription does an ahīna have an atirātra on both ends; and by explicit prescription a sattra has no atirātra, as in the case of the Agniṣṭomāyana, the Sārasvata-ayana, and the Viśvasṛjām-ayana.

26.12.289.s: katham u khalv eṣām̐ saṃnivāpaḥ syād iti
26.12.289.d: कथम् उ खल्व् एषाँ संनिवापः स्याद् इति
26.12.289.m: "How indeed should their mingling [saṃnivāpa] of the fires take place?"

26.12.289.s: sāvitrebhyaḥ prathamam̐ saṃnivaperan hutvā sāvitrāṇi visamārohyāgnihotrāṇi juhuyus |
26.12.289.d: सावित्रेभ्यः प्रथमँ संनिवपेरन् हुत्वा सावित्राणि विसमारोह्याग्निहोत्राणि जुहुयुस् ।
26.12.289.m: They should mingle [the fires] first before the sāvitra offerings; having offered the sāvitra oblations and having caused [the fires] to descend separately, they should offer the agnihotras.

26.12.289.s: atha vāyavyāya paśave saṃnivaperan vāyavyeneṣṭvā visamārohyaivāgnihotrāṇi juhuyus |
26.12.289.d: अथ वायव्याय पशवे संनिवपेरन् वायव्येनेष्ट्वा विसमारोह्यैवाग्निहोत्राणि जुहुयुस् ।
26.12.289.m: Or they should mingle [them] for the animal for Vāyu; having sacrificed with the animal for Vāyu and having caused [the fires] to descend separately, they should offer the agnihotras.

26.12.289.s: atha yadi dīkṣaṇīyāyai saṃnivaperam̐s teṣāṃ tat saṃnyuptāny eva syur vyudavasānīyāt |
26.12.289.d: अथ यदि दीक्षणीयायै संनिवपेरँस् तेषां तत् संन्युप्तान्य् एव स्युर् व्युदवसानीयात् ।
26.12.289.m: Or, if they should mingle [them] for the introductory offering [dīkṣaṇīyā], their fires would remain mingled until the final concluding bath offering [vyudavasānīyā].
Only after performing the concluding departure [vyudavasāna] should the neighbors perform the concluding tail-parts of the sacrifice.

26.12.289.s: katham u khalu saṃdīkṣitā viṣṇukramān kramerann iti
26.12.289.d: कथम् उ खलु संदीक्षिता विष्णुक्रमान् क्रमेरन्न् इति
26.12.289.m: "How indeed should those consecrated together stride the strides of Viṣṇu?"

26.12.289.s: mahāpāśābhiparītā vā krameran | api vā pāśān abhisaṃdhitvābhikramaḥ syād athāha kramasva | athāha kramasva | iti |
26.12.289.d: महापाशाभिपरीता वा क्रमेरन् । अपि वा पाशान् अभिसंधित्वाभिक्रमः स्याद् अथाह क्रमस्व । अथाह क्रमस्व । इति ।
26.12.289.m: Either they should stride encircled by a great cord, or there should be striding by joining cords, and he says: "Stride!" and he says: "Stride!"

26.12.290.s: atigurus tathā kalpaḥ syāt | yatho etat sūtraṃ bhavati ṣaṣṭhyām upasady uttaravedim̐ saṃnivapanty api vaikādaśyām iti |
26.12.290.d: अतिगुरुस् तथा कल्पः स्यात् । यथो एतत् सूत्रं भवति षष्ठ्याम् उपसद्य् उत्तरवेदिँ संनिवपन्त्य् अपि वैकादश्याम् इति ।
26.12.290.m: In that case the procedure would be too cumbersome. As to the rule: "On the sixth upasad day they cast the uttaravedi, or on the eleventh"—
this applies only to a rite without a fire-altar [agnicayana], not to one with a fire-altar.

26.12.290.s: katham u khalv eṣām ahīnasaṃtatir bhavatīti
26.12.290.d: कथम् उ खल्व् एषाम् अहीनसंततिर् भवतीति
26.12.290.m: "How indeed does the continuity of the ahīna rite occur for them?"

26.12.290.s: vasatīvarīṇām abhigrahaṇenādhvaryuḥ saṃtanotīdhmābarhiṣor upakalpanena ca payasāṃ viśāsanena ca vāco yamyena brahmātipraiṣeṇa hotā punarabhyāsena ca subrahmaṇyayodgātā yajñasya punarālambhena yajamānaḥ
26.12.290.d: वसतीवरीणाम् अभिग्रहणेनाध्वर्युः संतनोतीध्माबर्हिषोर् उपकल्पनेन च पयसां विशासनेन च वाचो यम्येन ब्रह्मातिप्रैषेण होता पुनरभ्यासेन च सुब्रह्मण्ययोद्गाता यज्ञस्य पुनरालम्भेन यजमानः
26.12.290.m: The adhvaryu maintains continuity by taking the vasatīvarī waters, by preparing the kindling wood and grass bundle, and by distributing the milks; the brahman priest by keeping silence; the hotṛ priest by the superior call and by repetition; the udgātṛ priest by the subrahmaṇyā chant; the sacrificer by taking hold of the sacrifice again.

26.12.290.s: pracaranta evaitad dhruvājyam̐ samādadate | athemāni savanāni barhīm̐ṣi saṃcinuyus
26.12.290.d: प्रचरन्त एवैतद् ध्रुवाज्यँ समाददते । अथेमानि सवनानि बर्हीँषि संचिनुयुस्
26.12.290.m: While performing the rites, they collect this constant clarified butter [dhruvājya]; then they should collect the grasses for these pressings.

26.12.290.s: teṣāṃ mahārātra utthāyāgnīdhra ājyāni gṛhṇanto jvalayerann iti ||
26.12.290.d: तेषां महारात्र उत्थायाग्नीध्र आज्यानि गृह्णन्तो ज्वलयेरन्न् इति ॥
26.12.290.m: Having risen in the late night, taking the clarified butter in the āgnīdhra fire shed, they should make it flame.

26.13.290.s: katham u khalu divā prātaranuvākasyāhna upakramo bhavatīti
26.13.290.d: कथम् उ खलु दिवा प्रातरनुवाकस्याह्न उपक्रमो भवतीति
26.13.290.m: "How indeed does the commencement of the day's morning recitation take place by day?"

26.13.290.s: tat patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ vā hṛdayaśūlāntaṃ vāhaḥ kṛtvā samupanahya rājānaṃ kāle vasatīvarīr abhigṛhyāhīnasaṃtatiṃ kṛtvā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāyāgnīdhraṃ drutvā samidddhārā yanti |
26.13.290.d: तत् पत्नीसंयाजान्तं वा हृदयशूलान्तं वाहः कृत्वा समुपनह्य राजानं काले वसतीवरीर् अभिगृह्याहीनसंततिं कृत्वा ग्रावोवायव्यँ संप्रक्षाल्य द्रोणकलशे दशापवित्रे समवधायाग्नीध्रं द्रुत्वा समिद्द्धारा यन्ति ।
26.13.290.m: Having concluded that day with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings or with the heart-spit offering, having tied up King Soma, having taken the vasatīvarī waters at the proper time, having secured the continuity of the ahīna, having washed the pressing stone and the vāyavya cups, having placed the ten-fringed purifier into the droṇakalaśa trough, having hastened to the āgnīdhra shed, the fuel-bearers go.

26.13.291.m: Having brought the firewood, they set it down near the āhavanīya fire.

26.13.291.s: parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣv āhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyām̐ saveśanīyāḥ samidho 'bhyādhāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya payām̐si viśiṣyāgnidhraṃ drutvāgnīdhre saṃveśanarūpāṇi kṛtvā prātaḥkarmaṇā pratipadyate
26.13.291.d: परिहृतासु वसतीवरीष्व् आहूतायाँ सुब्रह्मण्यायाँ सवेशनीयाः समिधो ऽभ्याधायेध्माबर्हिः संनह्य पयाँसि विशिष्याग्निध्रं द्रुत्वाग्नीध्रे संवेशनरूपाणि कृत्वा प्रातःकर्मणा प्रतिपद्यते
26.13.291.m: When the vasatīvarī waters have been carried around and the subrahmaṇyā has been called, having added the bed-time firesticks, bound the kindling wood and sacrificial grass, distributed the milks, run to the āgnīdhra shed, and performed the rites appropriate for retiring in the āgnīdhra shed, he begins the morning rite

26.13.291.s: prasiddhena mahārātrikeṇa siddham ata ūrdhvam upastambhanaṃ vā etad yajñasya yad atigrāhyāś cakre pṛṣṭhānīti
26.13.291.d: प्रसिद्धेन महारात्रिकेण सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् उपस्तम्भनं वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यद् अतिग्राह्याश् चक्रे पृष्ठानीति
26.13.291.m: according to the well-known late-night procedure. From this point on it is established. "This is indeed the support of the sacrifice, that the atigrāhya cups and the pṛṣṭha stotras are on the wheel."

26.13.291.s: trivṛc caikavim̐śaś ca cakre āgneya upastambhanam |
26.13.291.d: त्रिवृच् चैकविँशश् च चक्रे आग्नेय उपस्तम्भनम् ।
26.13.291.m: The trivṛt and the ekaviṃśa stomas are the support on the wheel belonging to Agni.

26.13.291.s: pañcadaśaś ca triṇavaś ca cakre aindra upastambhanam̐ saptadaśaś ca trayastrim̐śaś ca cakre saurya upastambhanam |
26.13.291.d: पञ्चदशश् च त्रिणवश् च चक्रे ऐन्द्र उपस्तम्भनँ सप्तदशश् च त्रयस्त्रिँशश् च चक्रे सौर्य उपस्तम्भनम् ।
26.13.291.m: The pañcadaśa and the triṇava stomas are the support on the wheel belonging to Indra; the saptadaśa and the trayastriṃśa stomas are the support on the wheel belonging to Sūrya.

26.13.291.s: yatho etad baudhāyanasya kalpaṃ vedayante nirmanthyo mantravān bhavatīti |
26.13.291.d: यथो एतद् बौधायनस्य कल्पं वेदयन्ते निर्मन्थ्यो मन्त्रवान् भवतीति ।
26.13.291.m: As to what they proclaim as Baudhāyana's procedure: "The produced fire is accompanied by mantras"—
here only the mantras of the adhvaryu are repeated, not those belonging to the churning of the fire.

26.13.291.s: svayam ṛtuyājam evaitad ahar bhavati naitad ahar anyonyasyartuyājaṃ yajatīti ||
26.13.291.d: स्वयम् ऋतुयाजम् एवैतद् अहर् भवति नैतद् अहर् अन्योन्यस्यर्तुयाजं यजतीति ॥
26.13.291.m: This day has its own offering to the seasons [ṛtuyāja]; on this day one does not perform the season-offering for another.

26.14.291.s: āśrāvyādhvaryur anyasmai grahaṃ pradāyaitenaiva yathetam etya jaghanena havirdhāne upaviśyartusaṃpraiṣam uktvopotthāya hutvā vyavanīya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya yatrāyākṣīt tat prāṅāsīno hotṛbhakṣaṃ bhakṣayet pratyaṅṅāsīno 'dhvaryubhakṣam |
26.14.291.d: आश्राव्याध्वर्युर् अन्यस्मै ग्रहं प्रदायैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य जघनेन हविर्धाने उपविश्यर्तुसंप्रैषम् उक्त्वोपोत्थाय हुत्वा व्यवनीय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य यत्रायाक्षीत् तत् प्राङासीनो होतृभक्षं भक्षयेत् प्रत्यङ्ङासीनो ऽध्वर्युभक्षम् ।
26.14.291.m: Having made the call, handed over the soma-cup to another, returned by the same way he came, sat down behind the two havirdhāna sheds, uttered the seasonal summoning-command, stood up, offered, poured down, and turned clockwise—seated facing east where he sacrificed, he should consume the hotṛ priest's portion; seated facing west, the adhvaryu priest's portion.

26.14.291.s: pārucchepīr hotā śam̐sati vālakhilyā maitrāvaruṇo viharati vṛṣākapiṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sī śam̐saty evayāmarutam acchāvākaḥ
26.14.291.d: पारुच्छेपीर् होता शँसति वालखिल्या मैत्रावरुणो विहरति वृषाकपिं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसी शँसत्य् एवयामरुतम् अच्छावाकः
26.14.291.m: The hotṛ priest recites the Pārucchepa verses; the maitrāvaruṇa distributes the Vālakhilyā verses; the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin recites the Vṛṣākapi hymn; the acchāvāka recites the Evayāmarut hymn.

26.14.292.s: kiṃkarmā tarhy adhvaryur bhavatīti pratyāgṛṇātīty eva brūyāt |
26.14.292.d: किंकर्मा तर्ह्य् अध्वर्युर् भवतीति प्रत्यागृणातीत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
26.14.292.m: If it is asked, 'What duty does the adhvaryu priest have then?', one should say only: 'He utters the response.'

26.14.292.s: yā etā adhvaryur anuṣṭubha uddhṛty āharati tāś catasro gāyatryas tās tisro 'nuṣṭubhaḥ
26.14.292.d: या एता अध्वर्युर् अनुष्टुभ उद्धृत्य् आहरति ताश् चतस्रो गायत्र्यस् तास् तिस्रो ऽनुष्टुभः
26.14.292.m: As for these anuṣṭubh verses that the adhvaryu priest takes out and brings: they are four gāyatrī verses, [or] they are three anuṣṭubh verses.

26.14.292.s: soma rājann ehy avaroha | ity etasyai gāyatryai padamātreṇa rājānam upāvaharet
26.14.292.d: सोम राजन्न् एह्य् अवरोह । इत्य् एतस्यै गायत्र्यै पदमात्रेण राजानम् उपावहरेत्
26.14.292.m: With just a quarter-verse of this gāyatrī: 'Come, King Soma, descend,' he should bring down King [Soma].

26.14.292.s: katham u khalu daśamam ahar bhaktyā sarvacaturvim̐śaṃ ca bhavati triṣṭomaṃ cānyatra tūṣṇīm̐stomād iti
26.14.292.d: कथम् उ खलु दशमम् अहर् भक्त्या सर्वचतुर्विँशं च भवति त्रिष्टोमं चान्यत्र तूष्णीँस्तोमाद् इति
26.14.292.m: Now, how indeed does the tenth day become dividedly both entirely twenty-four-fold and a triṣṭoma, apart from the silent praise?

26.14.292.s: caturvim̐śo bahiṣpavamānaḥ pañcadaśaṃ brahmasāma trayastrim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma
26.14.292.d: चतुर्विँशो बहिष्पवमानः पञ्चदशं ब्रह्मसाम त्रयस्त्रिँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम
26.14.292.m: The bahiṣpavamāna chant is twenty-four-fold; the brahma-sāman is fifteen-fold; the agniṣṭoma-sāman is thirty-three-fold.

26.14.292.s: tāsām u ha navāgacchanti tāś caturvim̐śatiḥ saṃpadyante |
26.14.292.d: तासाम् उ ह नवागच्छन्ति ताश् चतुर्विँशतिः संपद्यन्ते ।
26.14.292.m: And nine of these are obtained: they amount to twenty-four.

26.14.292.s: etad evāpi daśamam ahar bhaktyā sarvacaturvim̐śaṃ ca bhavati triṣṭomaṃ cānyatra tūṣṇīm̐stomād iti |
26.14.292.d: एतद् एवापि दशमम् अहर् भक्त्या सर्वचतुर्विँशं च भवति त्रिष्टोमं चान्यत्र तूष्णीँस्तोमाद् इति ।
26.14.292.m: Thus indeed the tenth day becomes dividedly both entirely twenty-four-fold and a triṣṭoma, apart from the silent praise.

26.14.292.s: upasṛjan mātre vatsaṃ dhārayan dharuṇo dhayan | iti
26.14.292.d: उपसृजन् मात्रे वत्सं धारयन् धरुणो धयन् । इति
26.14.292.m: [With the mantra:] 'Releasing the calf to the mother, the supporter nursing while sucking.'

26.14.293.s: kiṃdevatyā u khalv iyam āhutir bhavatīti
26.14.293.d: किंदेवत्या उ खल्व् इयम् आहुतिर् भवतीति
26.14.293.m: To what deity, indeed, belongs this offering?
One should simply say: 'It is dedicated to Prajāpati.'

26.15.293.s: athemaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ grahāgrair eva prativyūhāmas athemaṃ tasya navāhāni prativyūhaṃ gacchanti yāny anyāni prāyaṇīyodayanīyābhyāṃ daśamāc cāhnas |
26.15.293.d: अथेमं द्वादशाहं ग्रहाग्रैर् एव प्रतिव्यूहामस् अथेमं तस्य नवाहानि प्रतिव्यूहं गच्छन्ति यान्य् अन्यानि प्रायणीयोदयनीयाभ्यां दशमाच् चाह्नस् ।
26.15.293.m: Now we transpose this twelve-day rite by the cups taken first. Now nine days of it undergo transposition, which are other than the introductory and concluding days and other than the tenth day.

26.15.293.s: atha chandomās tat ṣaḍ eva svasthāno hi prathamas trirātras |
26.15.293.d: अथ छन्दोमास् तत् षड् एव स्वस्थानो हि प्रथमस् त्रिरात्रस् ।
26.15.293.m: Then the chandoma days: they are only six, for the first three-day period has its own proper place.

26.15.293.s: gāyatrīprātaḥsavane prathame trirātre 'ṣṭau kṛtvo 'gre prathamam upām̐śv abhiṣavam abhiṣuṇuyāt |
26.15.293.d: गायत्रीप्रातःसवने प्रथमे त्रिरात्रे ऽष्टौ कृत्वो ऽग्रे प्रथमम् उपाँश्व् अभिषवम् अभिषुणुयात् ।
26.15.293.m: In the first three-day period, which has gāyatrī for the morning pressing, he should first perform the upāṃśu-pressing eight times at the beginning.

26.15.293.s: dvādaśa kṛtvas tṛtīyam | mahām̐ indro nṛvad ā carṣaṇiprās | ity etayā triṣṭubhā māhendraṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
26.15.293.d: द्वादश कृत्वस् तृतीयम् । महाँ इन्द्रो नृवद् आ चर्षणिप्रास् । इत्य् एतया त्रिष्टुभा माहेन्द्रं गृह्णीयात् ।
26.15.293.m: Twelve times the third. With this triṣṭubh: 'Great is Indra, human-like, filling the folk,' he should draw the māhendra cup.

26.15.293.s: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣ ṭvam ity etayā jagatyā sāvitram
26.15.293.d: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष् ट्वम् इत्य् एतया जगत्या सावित्रम्
26.15.293.m: With this jagatī: 'O Savitar, with your unerring protectors,' [he should draw] the sāvitra cup.
He should prepare eight-pot-sherd cakes for the morning pressing.
Eleven-pot-sherd cakes for the midday pressing; twelve-pot-sherd cakes for the third pressing.

26.15.293.s: vasumadgaṇena gāyatracchandasā prātaḥsavanīyān bhakṣayet | rudravadgaṇena triṣṭupchandasā mādhyaṃdinīyān
26.15.293.d: वसुमद्गणेन गायत्रच्छन्दसा प्रातःसवनीयान् भक्षयेत् । रुद्रवद्गणेन त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसा माध्यंदिनीयान्
26.15.293.m: With the troop possessing the Vasus, in the gāyatrī metre, he should consume [the offerings] of the morning pressing; with the troop possessing the Rudras, in the triṣṭubh metre, those of the midday pressing;
with the troop possessing the Ādityas, in the jagatī metre, those of the third pressing.

26.15.294.s: atha jagatīprātaḥsavane dvitīye trirātre dvādaśa kṛtvo 'gre prathamam upām̐śv abhiṣavam abhiṣuṇyāt |
26.15.294.d: अथ जगतीप्रातःसवने द्वितीये त्रिरात्रे द्वादश कृत्वो ऽग्रे प्रथमम् उपाँश्व् अभिषवम् अभिषुण्यात् ।
26.15.294.m: Then in the second three-day period, which has jagatī for the morning pressing, he should first perform the upāṃśu-pressing twelve times at the beginning.

26.15.294.s: ekādaśa kṛtvas tṛtīyam | mahām̐ indro ya ojasā | ity etayā gāyatryā māhendraṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
26.15.294.d: एकादश कृत्वस् तृतीयम् । महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा । इत्य् एतया गायत्र्या माहेन्द्रं ग्रहं गृह्णीयात् ।
26.15.294.m: Eleven times the third. With this gāyatrī: 'Great is Indra, who by his strength,' he should draw the māhendra cup.

26.15.294.s: vāmam adya savitar ity etayā triṣṭubhā sāvitram |
26.15.294.d: वामम् अद्य सवितर् इत्य् एतया त्रिष्टुभा सावित्रम् ।
26.15.294.m: With this triṣṭubh: 'Today, O Savitar, what is lovely,' [he should draw] the sāvitra cup.
He should prepare twelve-pot-sherd cakes for the morning pressing.

26.15.294.s: aṣṭākapālān mādhyaṃdinīyān ekādaśakapālām̐s tṛtīyasavanīyān ādityavadgaṇena jagatīcchandasā prātaḥsavanīyān bhakṣayet |
26.15.294.d: अष्टाकपालान् माध्यंदिनीयान् एकादशकपालाँस् तृतीयसवनीयान् आदित्यवद्गणेन जगतीच्छन्दसा प्रातःसवनीयान् भक्षयेत् ।
26.15.294.m: Eight-pot-sherd cakes for the midday pressing; eleven-pot-sherd cakes for the third pressing. With the troop possessing the Ādityas, in the jagatī metre, he should consume [the offerings] of the morning pressing;
with the troop possessing the Vasus, in the gāyatrī metre, those of the midday pressing;
with the troop possessing the Rudras, in the triṣṭubh metre, those of the third pressing.

26.15.294.s: atha triṣṭupprātaḥsavane tṛtīye trirātra ekādaśa kṛtvo 'gre prathamam upām̐śv abhiṣavam abhiṣuṇuyāt |
26.15.294.d: अथ त्रिष्टुप्प्रातःसवने तृतीये त्रिरात्र एकादश कृत्वो ऽग्रे प्रथमम् उपाँश्व् अभिषवम् अभिषुणुयात् ।
26.15.294.m: Then in the third three-day period, which has triṣṭubh for the morning pressing, he should first perform the upāṃśu-pressing eleven times at the beginning.

26.15.294.s: dvādaśa kṛtvo dvitīyam aṣṭau kṛtvas tṛtīyam |
26.15.294.d: द्वादश कृत्वो द्वितीयम् अष्टौ कृत्वस् तृतीयम् ।
26.15.294.m: Twelve times the second, eight times the third.

26.15.294.s: mahām̐ indro ya ojasā | ity etāṃ gāyatrīṃ trir abhyāvartayed anupayāmām |
26.15.294.d: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा । इत्य् एतां गायत्रीं त्रिर् अभ्यावर्तयेद् अनुपयामाम् ।
26.15.294.m: This gāyatrī: 'Great is Indra, who by his strength,' he should repeat three times without an upayāma formula.

26.15.294.s: sā jagatī saṃpadyate tayā māhendraṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
26.15.294.d: सा जगती संपद्यते तया माहेन्द्रं गृह्णीयात् ।
26.15.294.m: It becomes a jagatī; with it he should draw the māhendra cup.

26.15.294.s: hiraṇyapāṇim ūtaye | ity etayā gāyatryā sāvitram ekādaśakapālān prātaḥsavanīyān kuryāt |
26.15.294.d: हिरण्यपाणिम् ऊतये । इत्य् एतया गायत्र्या सावित्रम् एकादशकपालान् प्रातःसवनीयान् कुर्यात् ।
26.15.294.m: With this gāyatrī: 'The golden-handed for help,' [he should draw] the sāvitra cup. He should prepare eleven-pot-sherd cakes for the morning pressing.
Twelve-pot-sherd cakes for the midday pressing; eight-pot-sherd cakes for the third pressing.
With the troop of the Rudras, with the triṣṭubh metre, he should consume those belonging to the morning pressing.
With the troop of the Ādityas, with the jagatī metre, those belonging to the midday [pressing];
With the troop of the Vasus, with the gāyatrī metre, those belonging to the third pressing.

26.16.295.s: athāyaṃ vaiṣuvato labheta māsagaṇānām ity eka āhuḥ saptadaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado vaiṣuvataṃ trim̐śattamam |
26.16.295.d: अथायं वैषुवतो लभेत मासगणानाम् इत्य् एक आहुः सप्तदश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदो वैषुवतं त्रिँशत्तमम् ।
26.16.295.m: Now, some say this [central day] should receive the central day (vaiṣuvata) among the groups of months: seventeen consecrations, twelve upasads, and the central day as the thirtieth.

26.16.295.s: katham u khalu goāyubhyām̐ stomā bhavantīti
